dbg = sys.modules.get('dbg', None)
uiCommon = sys.modules.get('uiCommon', None)
ui_mod = sys.modules.get('ui', None)

# ============================================================
#  OYUN OBJESI BULUCU
# ============================================================
def find_obj(class_name):
    try:
        for obj in gc.get_objects():
            try:
                if type(obj).__name__ == class_name:
                    return obj
            except:
                pass
    except:
        pass
    return None

def find_obj_visible(class_name):
    try:
        for obj in gc.get_objects():
            try:
                if type(obj).__name__ == class_name:
                    if hasattr(obj, 'IsShow') and obj.IsShow():
                        return obj
            except:
                pass
    except:
        pass
    return None

def find_all_objs(class_name):
    result = []
    try:
        for obj in gc.get_objects():
            try:
                if type(obj).__name__ == class_name:
                    result.append(obj)
            except:
                pass
    except:
        pass
    return result

# ============================================================
#  SAHNE TESPITI
# ============================================================
def detect_scene():
    global _current_scene, _scene_name

    lw = find_obj('LoginWindow')
    if lw:
        try:
            lb = getattr(lw, 'loginBoard', None)
            if lb and hasattr(lb, 'IsShow') and lb.IsShow():
                _current_scene = 'LOGIN'
                _scene_name = 'Giris Ekrani'
                return
        except:
            pass
        try:
            sb = getattr(lw, 'serverBoard', None)
            if sb and hasattr(sb, 'IsShow') and sb.IsShow():
                _current_scene = 'LOGIN'
                _scene_name = 'Server Secim Ekrani'
                return
        except:
            pass

    sw = find_obj('SelectCharacterWindow')
    if sw:
        try:
            if sw.IsShow():
                _current_scene = 'SELECT'
                _scene_name = 'Karakter Secim Ekrani'
                return
        except:
            pass

    for en in ('ReselectEmpireWindow', 'SelectEmpireWindow'):
        ew = find_obj(en)
        if ew:
            try:
                if ew.IsShow():
                    _current_scene = 'EMPIRE'
                    _scene_name = 'Bayrak Secim Ekrani'
                    return
            except:
                _current_scene = 'EMPIRE'
                _scene_name = 'Bayrak Secim Ekrani'
                return

    for cn in ('CreateCharacterWindow', 'CharacterCreateWindow'):
        cw = find_obj(cn)
        if cw:
            try:
                if cw.IsShow():
                    _current_scene = 'CREATE'
                    _scene_name = 'Karakter Olusturma Ekrani'
                    return
            except:
                pass

    gw = find_obj('GameWindow')
    if gw:
        try:
            if gw.IsShow():
                _current_scene = 'GAME'
                _scene_name = 'Oyun Ici'
                return
        except:
            pass

    stm = find_obj('MainStream')
    if stm:
        try:
            pw = getattr(stm, 'curPhaseWindow', None)
            if pw:
                pn = type(pw).__name__
                if 'Login' in pn:
                    _current_scene = 'LOGIN'
                    _scene_name = 'Giris Ekrani (phase)'
                    return
                elif 'Select' in pn and 'Character' in pn:
                    _current_scene = 'SELECT'
                    _scene_name = 'Karakter Secim (phase)'
                    return
                elif 'Empire' in pn:
                    _current_scene = 'EMPIRE'
                    _scene_name = 'Bayrak Secim (phase)'
                    return
                elif 'Game' in pn:
                    _current_scene = 'GAME'
                    _scene_name = 'Oyun Ici (phase)'
                    return
        except:
            pass

    _current_scene = 'UNKNOWN'
    _scene_name = 'Bilinmiyor'

# ============================================================
#  BILGI TOPLAMA
# ============================================================
def get_server_list():
    servers = []
    lw = find_obj('LoginWindow')
    if not lw:
        return servers
    try:
        sl = getattr(lw, 'serverList', None)
        if sl:
            cnt = sl.GetItemCount()
            for i in range(cnt):
                try:
                    txt = sl.GetItemText(i)
                    servers.append({'index': i, 'name': safe_str(txt)})
                except:
                    servers.append({'index': i, 'name': 'Server %d' % i})
    except:
        pass
    return servers

def get_channel_list():
    channels = []
    lw = find_obj('LoginWindow')
    if not lw:
        return channels
    try:
        cl = getattr(lw, 'channelList', None)
        if cl:
            cnt = cl.GetItemCount()
            for i in range(cnt):
                try:
                    txt = cl.GetItemText(i)
                    channels.append({'index': i, 'name': safe_str(txt)})
                except:
                    channels.append({'index': i, 'name': 'CH %d' % i})
    except:
        pass
    return channels

def get_character_list():
    chars = []
    if not net:
        return chars
    for i in range(4):
        try:
            cid = net.GetAccountCharacterSlotDataInteger(i, SLOT_ID)
        except:
            cid = 0
        if cid == 0:
            continue
        name = '?'
        race = 0
        level = 0
        try:
            name = net.GetAccountCharacterSlotDataString(i, SLOT_NAME)
        except:
            pass
        try:
            race = net.GetAccountCharacterSlotDataInteger(i, SLOT_RACE)
        except:
            pass
        try:
            level = net.GetAccountCharacterSlotDataInteger(i, SLOT_LEVEL)
        except:
            pass
        chars.append({
            'slot': i,
            'id': cid,
            'name': safe_str(name),
            'race': race,
            'level': level,
            'job': JOB_NAMES.get(race, '?'),
            'gender': GENDER_NAMES.get(race, '?'),
        })
    return chars

def get_account_empire():
    if not net:
        return 0
    try:
        return net.GetEmpireID()
    except:
        return 0

# ============================================================
#  HATA IZLEME (Recorder Lite)
# ============================================================
_rec_messages = []
_rec_errors = []
_rec_hooked = [False]

ERROR_PATTERNS = [
    ('bakim', 'MAINTENANCE', 'Server bakimda'),
    ('maintenance', 'MAINTENANCE', 'Server bakimda'),
    ('under maintenance', 'MAINTENANCE', 'Server bakimda'),
    ('baglanti', 'CONNECT_FAIL', 'Baglanti hatasi'),
    ('connection', 'CONNECT_FAIL', 'Baglanti hatasi'),
    ('connect fail', 'CONNECT_FAIL', 'Baglanti kurulamadi'),
    ('yanlis sifre', 'WRONG_PWD', 'Yanlis sifre'),
    ('wrong password', 'WRONG_PWD', 'Yanlis sifre'),
    ('hesap yok', 'NO_ACCOUNT', 'Hesap bulunamadi'),
    ('not exist', 'NO_ACCOUNT', 'Hesap bulunamadi'),
    ('ban', 'BANNED', 'Hesap yasakli'),
    ('block', 'BLOCKED', 'Hesap engelli'),
    ('full', 'SERVER_FULL', 'Server dolu'),
    ('too many', 'SERVER_FULL', 'Cok fazla kullanici'),
]

def check_error_text(text):
    global _last_error, _last_error_code
    if not text:
        return False
    low = text.lower()
    for pattern, code, msg in ERROR_PATTERNS:
        if pattern in low:
            _last_error = msg
            _last_error_code = code
            _rec_errors.append('[%s] %s' % (time.strftime('%H:%M:%S'), text))
            if len(_rec_errors) > 100:
                _rec_errors.pop(0)
            return True
    return False

# ============================================================
#  HOOK FABRIKALARI (Python 2.7 UYUMLU - *args sonra kwarg YOK)
# ============================================================
def _make_chat_hook(orig_fn):
    def _h_chat(chat_type, msg, *args):
        try:
            s = clean_text(msg)
            if s:
                _rec_messages.append(s)
                if len(_rec_messages) > 100:
                    _rec_messages.pop(0)
                check_error_text(s)
        except:
            pass
        return orig_fn(chat_type, msg, *args)
    _h_chat._maxpy_hook = True
    _h_chat._maxpy_orig = orig_fn
    return _h_chat

def _make_log_hook(orig_fn):
    def _h_log(*args):
        try:
            if args:
                s = clean_text(args[0])
                if s:
                    _rec_messages.append(s)
                    if len(_rec_messages) > 100:
                        _rec_messages.pop(0)
                    check_error_text(s)
        except:
            pass
        return orig_fn(*args)
    _h_log._maxpy_hook = True
    _h_log._maxpy_orig = orig_fn
    return _h_log

def hook_recorder():
    global _rec_hooked
    if _rec_hooked[0]:
        return

    if chat_mod and hasattr(chat_mod, 'AppendChat'):
        fn = chat_mod.AppendChat
        if not getattr(fn, '_maxpy_hook', False):
            chat_mod.AppendChat = _make_chat_hook(fn)

    if dbg and hasattr(dbg, 'LogBox'):
        fn = dbg.LogBox
        if not getattr(fn, '_maxpy_hook', False):
            dbg.LogBox = _make_log_hook(fn)

    _rec_hooked[0] = True

def unhook_recorder():
    if not _rec_hooked[0]:
        return
    try:
        if chat_mod and hasattr(chat_mod, 'AppendChat'):
            fn = chat_mod.AppendChat
            if getattr(fn, '_maxpy_hook', False):
                chat_mod.AppendChat = fn._maxpy_orig
        if dbg and hasattr(dbg, 'LogBox'):
            fn = dbg.LogBox
            if getattr(fn, '_maxpy_hook', False):
                dbg.LogBox = fn._maxpy_orig
    except:
        pass
    _rec_hooked[0] = False

# ============================================================
#  SAHNE DEGISTIRICI
# ============================================================
def change_scene(target):
    global _last_log
    stm = find_obj('MainStream')
    if not stm:
        _last_log = 'MainStream bulunamadi!'
        return False
    try:
        if target == 'LOGIN':
            stm.SetLoginPhase()
            _last_log = 'Sahne: Login'
        elif target == 'SELECT':
            stm.SetSelectCharacterPhase()
            _last_log = 'Sahne: Karakter Secim'
        elif target == 'EMPIRE':
            stm.SetSelectEmpirePhase()
            _last_log = 'Sahne: Bayrak Secim'
        elif target == 'CREATE':
            stm.SetCreateCharacterPhase()
            _last_log = 'Sahne: Karakter Olusturma'
        else:
            return False
        time.sleep(1)
        return True
    except Exception:
        _last_log = 'Sahne degistirme hatasi'
        return False

# ============================================================
#  LOGIN ISLEMLERI
# ============================================================
def do_select_server_channel(server_idx, ch_idx):
    global _last_log
    lw = find_obj('LoginWindow')
    if not lw:
        _last_log = 'LoginWindow bulunamadi!'
        return False
    try:
        sl = getattr(lw, 'serverList', None)
        cl = getattr(lw, 'channelList', None)
        if sl:
            sl.SelectItem(server_idx + 1)
        if cl:
            cl.SelectItem(ch_idx + 1)
        _last_log = 'Server=%d CH=%d secildi' % (server_idx, ch_idx)
        time.sleep(0.3)
        btn = getattr(lw, 'serverSelectButton', None)
        if btn:
            btn.CallEvent()
            _last_log = 'Server secim butonu tiklandi'
        time.sleep(0.5)
        return True
    except Exception:
        _last_log = 'Server/CH secim hatasi'
        return False

def do_enter_credentials(username, password):
    global _last_log
    lw = find_obj('LoginWindow')
    if not lw:
        _last_log = 'LoginWindow bulunamadi!'
        return False
    try:
        id_edit = getattr(lw, 'idEditLine', None)
        pwd_edit = getattr(lw, 'pwdEditLine', None)
        if id_edit:
            id_edit.SetText(username)
        if pwd_edit:
            pwd_edit.SetText(password)
        _last_log = 'Kullanici adi ve sifre girildi'
        time.sleep(0.3)
        login_btn = getattr(lw, 'loginButton', None)
        if login_btn:
            login_btn.CallEvent()
            _last_log = 'Login butonu tiklandi'
        time.sleep(0.5)
        return True
    except Exception:
        _last_log = 'Credential giris hatasi'
        return False

def do_login(server_idx, ch_idx, username, password):
    global _last_log
    if not do_select_server_channel(server_idx, ch_idx):
        return False
    time.sleep(0.5)
    if not do_enter_credentials(username, password):
        return False
    return True

def wait_login_result(timeout=30):
    global _last_log, _last_error, _last_error_code
    start = time.time()
    while time.time() - start < timeout:
        if _stop_flag[0]:
            return 'STOPPED'
        time.sleep(0.3)
        detect_scene()
        if _current_scene == 'SELECT':
            _last_log = 'Login basarili - Karakter secim ekraninda'
            return 'SUCCESS'
        if _current_scene == 'EMPIRE':
            _last_log = 'Login basarili - Bayrak secim ekraninda'
            return 'SUCCESS_EMPIRE'
        if _last_error_code:
            return 'FAILED'
        lw = find_obj('LoginWindow')
        if lw:
            try:
                cd = getattr(lw, 'connectingDialog', None)
                if cd and hasattr(cd, 'IsShow') and cd.IsShow():
                    continue
            except:
                pass
    return 'TIMEOUT'

# ============================================================
#  KARAKTER ISLEMLERI
# ============================================================
def do_select_character(slot):
    global _last_log
    sw = find_obj('SelectCharacterWindow')
    if not sw:
        _last_log = 'SelectCharacterWindow bulunamadi!'
        return False
    try:
        if hasattr(sw, 'SelectSlot'):
            sw.SelectSlot(slot)
        else:
            sw.slot = slot
        time.sleep(0.3)
        _last_log = 'Slot %d secildi' % slot
        return True
    except Exception:
        _last_log = 'Karakter secim hatasi'
        return False

def do_select_character_by_name(name):
    global _last_log
    chars = get_character_list()
    for c in chars:
        if c['name'].lower() == name.lower():
            return do_select_character(c['slot'])
    _last_log = '"%s" isimli karakter bulunamadi!' % name
    return False

def do_enter_game(slot):
    global _last_log
    sw = find_obj('SelectCharacterWindow')
    if not sw:
        _last_log = 'SelectCharacterWindow bulunamadi!'
        return False
    try:
        if hasattr(sw, 'SelectSlot'):
            sw.SelectSlot(slot)
        else:
            sw.slot = slot
        time.sleep(0.3)
        if hasattr(sw, 'StartGame'):
            sw.StartGame()
            _last_log = 'StartGame cagrildi (slot %d)' % slot
            return True
    except Exception:
        _last_log = 'StartGame hatasi'

    if net:
        try:
            net.DirectEnter(slot)
            _last_log = 'DirectEnter(%d) cagrildi' % slot
            return True
        except Exception:
            _last_log = 'DirectEnter hatasi'
    return False

def wait_enter_game(timeout=30):
    global _last_log
    start = time.time()
    while time.time() - start < timeout:
        if _stop_flag[0]:
            return 'STOPPED'
        time.sleep(0.5)
        detect_scene()
        if _current_scene == 'GAME':
            _last_log = 'Oyuna giris basarili!'
            return 'SUCCESS'
        if _last_error_code:
            return 'FAILED'
    return 'TIMEOUT'

# ============================================================
#  BAYRAK SECIMI
# ============================================================
def do_select_empire(empire_id):
    global _last_log
    ew = None
    for en in ('ReselectEmpireWindow', 'SelectEmpireWindow'):
        ew = find_obj(en)
        if ew:
            break
    if not ew:
        _last_log = 'Empire Window bulunamadi!'
        return False

    try:
        if hasattr(ew, 'OnSelectEmpire'):
            ew.OnSelectEmpire(empire_id)
            _last_log = 'OnSelectEmpire(%d) OK' % empire_id
            time.sleep(0.5)
    except Exception:
        _last_log = 'OnSelectEmpire hatasi'

    try:
        ew.empireID = empire_id
    except:
        pass

    if net and hasattr(net, 'SendSelectEmpirePacket'):
        try:
            net.SendSelectEmpirePacket(empire_id)
            _last_log = 'SendSelectEmpirePacket(%d) OK' % empire_id
            time.sleep(1)
        except:
            pass

    try:
        if hasattr(ew, 'ClickSelectButton'):
            ew.ClickSelectButton()
            _last_log = 'ClickSelectButton OK'
            time.sleep(1)
            return True
    except Exception:
        _last_log = 'ClickSelectButton hatasi'

    try:
        ed = getattr(ew, 'ElementDictionary', None)
        if ed:
            sb = ed.get('select_button', None)
            if sb and hasattr(sb, 'CallEvent'):
                sb.CallEvent()
                _last_log = 'select_button.CallEvent OK'
                time.sleep(1)
                return True
    except:
        pass

    return False

# ============================================================
#  KARAKTER OLUSTURMA
# ============================================================
def do_create_character(slot, name, race, empire):
    global _last_log
    if not name:
        name = make_random_name()

    if net and hasattr(net, 'SendCreateCharacterPacket'):
        try:
            use_empire = empire
            if use_empire == 0:
                use_empire = get_account_empire()
            if use_empire == 0:
                use_empire = 1
            net.SendCreateCharacterPacket(slot, name, race, use_empire)
            _last_log = 'SendCreateCharacterPacket(%d, "%s", %d, %d) OK' % (slot, name, race, use_empire)
            return True
        except Exception:
            _last_log = 'SendCreateCharacterPacket hatasi'

    sw = find_obj('SelectCharacterWindow')
    if sw:
        try:
            if hasattr(sw, 'MakeCharacter'):
                sw.MakeCharacter()
                time.sleep(1)
        except:
            pass

        nib = getattr(sw, 'nameInputBoard', None)
        if nib:
            try:
                nib_ch = getattr(nib, 'Children', None)
                if nib_ch:
                    for nc in nib_ch:
                        if 'EditLine' in type(nc).__name__:
                            nc.SetText(name)
                            break
            except:
                pass
            try:
                if hasattr(sw, 'AcceptInputName'):
                    sw.AcceptInputName()
                    _last_log = 'AcceptInputName OK'
                    return True
            except:
                pass
            try:
                if hasattr(sw, 'CreateCharacter'):
                    sw.CreateCharacter()
                    _last_log = 'CreateCharacter OK'
                    return True
            except:
                pass

    return False

def wait_create_result(slot, timeout=20):
    global _last_log
    start = time.time()
    while time.time() - start < timeout:
        if _stop_flag[0]:
            return False
        time.sleep(0.5)
        if net:
            try:
                cid = net.GetAccountCharacterSlotDataInteger(slot, SLOT_ID)
                if cid != 0:
                    _last_log = 'Karakter olusturuldu! (slot %d)' % slot
                    return True
            except:
                pass
    return False

# ============================================================
#  DURUM OLUSTURUCU
# ============================================================
def build_status():
    global _status_last_time

    detect_scene()
    servers = get_server_list()
    channels = get_channel_list()
    chars = get_character_list()
    empire = get_account_empire()

    d = {}
    d['scene'] = _current_scene
    d['scene_name'] = _scene_name
    d['server_count'] = len(servers)
    for i, s in enumerate(servers):
        d['server_%d' % i] = s['name']
    d['ch_count'] = len(channels)
    for i, c in enumerate(channels):
        d['ch_%d' % i] = c['name']
    d['char_count'] = len(chars)
    for i, c in enumerate(chars):
        d['char_%d_name' % i] = c['name']
        d['char_%d_level' % i] = c['level']
        d['char_%d_race' % i] = c['race']
        d['char_%d_job' % i] = c['job']
        d['char_%d_gender' % i] = c['gender']
        d['char_%d_slot' % i] = c['slot']
    d['account_empire'] = empire
    d['error'] = _last_error
    d['error_code'] = _last_error_code
    d['log'] = _last_log
    d['auto_state'] = _auto_state
    d['auto_detail'] = _auto_detail
    d['pid'] = MY_PID

    return to_json(d)

# ============================================================
#  KOMUT ISLEYICI
# ============================================================
def handle_command(cmd_json):
    global _last_log, _last_error, _last_error_code
    global _auto_state, _auto_detail, _auto_config
    global _auto_char_before, _auto_create_remaining, _auto_create_done
    global _auto_wait_until, _auto_retry_count

    cmd = from_json(cmd_json)
    if not cmd:
        return

    action = cmd.get('cmd', '')
    _last_error = ''
    _last_error_code = ''

    if action == 'GET_STATUS':
        _last_log = 'Durum guncellendi'

    elif action == 'SCENE_CHANGE':
        target = cmd.get('target', 'SELECT')
        change_scene(target)

    elif action == 'LOGIN':
        srv = cmd.get('server_idx', 0)
        ch = cmd.get('ch_idx', 0)
        user = cmd.get('username', '')
        pwd = cmd.get('password', '')
        _last_log = 'Login baslatildi (Server=%d CH=%d)' % (srv, ch)
        if do_login(srv, ch, user, pwd):
            result = wait_login_result(30)
            _last_log = 'Login sonucu: %s' % result

    elif action == 'SELECT_CHAR':
        slot = cmd.get('slot', -1)
        name = cmd.get('name', '')
        if name:
            do_select_character_by_name(name)
        elif slot >= 0:
            do_select_character(slot)

    elif action == 'ENTER_GAME':
        slot = cmd.get('slot', 0)
        name = cmd.get('name', '')
        if name:
            chars = get_character_list()
            for c in chars:
                if c['name'].lower() == name.lower():
                    slot = c['slot']
                    break
        if do_enter_game(slot):
            result = wait_enter_game(30)
            _last_log = 'Oyuna giris sonucu: %s' % result

    elif action == 'SELECT_EMPIRE':
        empire = cmd.get('empire', 1)
        do_select_empire(empire)

    elif action == 'CREATE_CHAR':
        empire = cmd.get('empire', 1)
        race = cmd.get('race', 3)
        name = cmd.get('name', '')
        count = cmd.get('count', 1)

        chars = get_character_list()
        used_slots = set([c['slot'] for c in chars])
        empty_slots = [i for i in range(4) if i not in used_slots]

        if not empty_slots:
            _last_log = 'Bos slot yok! Max 4 karakter.'
            return

        actual_count = min(count, len(empty_slots))
        created = 0
        for i in range(actual_count):
            slot = empty_slots[i]
            cname = name if (name and i == 0) else make_random_name()
            _last_log = 'Karakter olusturuluyor: slot=%d isim=%s' % (slot, cname)
            if do_create_character(slot, cname, race, empire):
                if wait_create_result(slot, 20):
                    created += 1
                else:
                    _last_log = 'Karakter olusturma TIMEOUT (slot %d)' % slot
                    cname2 = make_random_name()
                    if do_create_character(slot, cname2, race, empire):
                        if wait_create_result(slot, 15):
                            created += 1
            time.sleep(1)

        _last_log = '%d/%d karakter olusturuldu' % (created, actual_count)

    elif action == 'AUTO_ALL':
        _auto_config = {
            'server_idx': cmd.get('server_idx', 0),
            'ch_idx': cmd.get('ch_idx', 0),
            'username': cmd.get('username', ''),
            'password': cmd.get('password', ''),
            'create_count': cmd.get('create_count', 0),
            'empire': cmd.get('empire', 1),
            'race': cmd.get('race', 3),
            'enter_slot': cmd.get('enter_slot', 0),
            'enter_name': cmd.get('enter_name', ''),
        }
        _auto_state = 'DETECT'
        _auto_detail = 'Baslatildi'
        _auto_retry_count = 0
        _auto_create_done = 0
        _auto_wait_until = 0.0
        _last_log = 'AUTO ALL baslatildi'

    elif action == 'STOP':
        _auto_state = 'IDLE'
        _auto_detail = ''
        _stop_flag[0] = True
        _last_log = 'Durdurma komutu alindi'

    elif action == 'STOP_AUTO':
        _auto_state = 'IDLE'
        _auto_detail = ''
        _last_log = 'AUTO ALL durduruldu'

# ============================================================
#  AUTO ALL MOTORU
# ============================================================
def auto_step():
    global _auto_state, _auto_detail, _auto_config
    global _auto_char_before, _auto_create_remaining, _auto_create_done
    global _auto_wait_until, _auto_retry_count, _last_log, _last_error, _last_error_code

    now = time.time()
    if now < _auto_wait_until:
        return

    if _auto_state == 'IDLE':
        return

    detect_scene()

    if _auto_state == 'DETECT':
        _auto_detail = 'Sahne tespiti: %s' % _scene_name
        if _current_scene == 'LOGIN':
            _auto_state = 'LOGIN_SERVER'
        elif _current_scene == 'SELECT':
            _auto_state = 'SELECT_CHECK'
        elif _current_scene == 'EMPIRE':
            _auto_state = 'CREATE_EMPIRE'
        elif _current_scene == 'CREATE':
            _auto_state = 'CREATE_FILL'
        elif _current_scene == 'GAME':
            _auto_state = 'DONE'
            _auto_detail = 'Zaten oyunda'
        else:
            _auto_wait_until = now + 2
            _auto_retry_count += 1
            if _auto_retry_count > 30:
                _auto_state = 'ERROR'
                _auto_detail = 'Sahne tespit edilemedi (60s)'

    elif _auto_state == 'LOGIN_SERVER':
        _auto_detail = 'Server/CH seciliyor'
        srv = _auto_config.get('server_idx', 0)
        ch = _auto_config.get('ch_idx', 0)
        if do_select_server_channel(srv, ch):
            _auto_state = 'LOGIN_CRED'
            _auto_wait_until = now + 1
        else:
            _auto_wait_until = now + 2
            _auto_retry_count += 1
            if _auto_retry_count > 10:
                _auto_state = 'ERROR'
                _auto_detail = 'Server/CH secilemedi'

    elif _auto_state == 'LOGIN_CRED':
        _auto_detail = 'Giris bilgileri giriliyor'
        user = _auto_config.get('username', '')
        pwd = _auto_config.get('password', '')
        _last_error = ''
        _last_error_code = ''
        if do_enter_credentials(user, pwd):
            _auto_state = 'LOGIN_WAIT'
            _auto_wait_until = now + 2
            _auto_retry_count = 0
        else:
            _auto_wait_until = now + 2
            _auto_retry_count += 1
            if _auto_retry_count > 5:
                _auto_state = 'ERROR'
                _auto_detail = 'Credential girilemedi'

    elif _auto_state == 'LOGIN_WAIT':
        _auto_detail = 'Login sonucu bekleniyor'
        detect_scene()
        if _current_scene == 'SELECT':
            _auto_state = 'SELECT_CHECK'
            _auto_detail = 'Login basarili!'
            _last_log = 'AUTO: Login basarili'
            _auto_retry_count = 0
        elif _current_scene == 'EMPIRE':
            _auto_state = 'CREATE_EMPIRE'
            _auto_detail = 'Login basarili - bayrak secimi gerekli'
            _auto_retry_count = 0
        elif _last_error_code == 'MAINTENANCE':
            _auto_state = 'RETRY_MAINTENANCE'
            _auto_detail = 'Server bakimda - 10dk beklenecek'
            _auto_wait_until = now + RETRY_MAINTENANCE
        elif _last_error_code in ('CONNECT_FAIL', 'SERVER_FULL'):
            _auto_retry_count += 1
            _auto_detail = 'Baglanti hatasi - tekrar denenecek (%d)' % _auto_retry_count
            _auto_wait_until = now + RETRY_CONNECT
            if _auto_retry_count > 5:
                _auto_state = 'ERROR'
                _auto_detail = 'Baglanti kurulamadi (5 deneme)'
        elif _last_error_code in ('WRONG_PWD', 'NO_ACCOUNT', 'BANNED', 'BLOCKED'):
            _auto_state = 'ERROR'
            _auto_detail = 'Login hatasi: %s' % _last_error
        else:
            _auto_wait_until = now + 1
            _auto_retry_count += 1
            if _auto_retry_count > 30:
                _auto_state = 'ERROR'
                _auto_detail = 'Login timeout'

    elif _auto_state == 'RETRY_MAINTENANCE':
        _auto_detail = 'Bakim bekleniyor...'
        _auto_state = 'LOGIN_SERVER'
        _auto_retry_count = 0
        _last_error = ''
        _last_error_code = ''

    elif _auto_state == 'SELECT_CHECK':
        chars = get_character_list()
        _auto_char_before = len(chars)
        create_count = _auto_config.get('create_count', 0)

        if create_count > 0 and len(chars) < 4:
            remaining = min(create_count, 4 - len(chars))
            if remaining > 0:
                _auto_create_remaining = remaining
                empire = get_account_empire()
                if empire == 0:
                    _auto_state = 'CREATE_EMPIRE'
                    _auto_detail = 'Bayrak secimi gerekli'
                else:
                    _auto_state = 'CREATE_DO'
                    _auto_detail = '%d karakter olusturulacak' % remaining
            else:
                _auto_state = 'ENTER_PREPARE'
        else:
            _auto_state = 'ENTER_PREPARE'
            _auto_detail = 'Karakter secimi yapilacak'

    elif _auto_state == 'CREATE_EMPIRE':
        empire = _auto_config.get('empire', 1)
        _auto_detail = 'Bayrak seciliyor: %s' % EMPIRE_NAMES.get(empire, '?')

        if _current_scene != 'EMPIRE':
            sw = find_obj('SelectCharacterWindow')
            if sw and hasattr(sw, 'MakeCharacter'):
                try:
                    sw.MakeCharacter()
                    time.sleep(1)
                except:
                    pass
            else:
                change_scene('EMPIRE')
            _auto_wait_until = now + 2
            return

        if do_select_empire(empire):
            _auto_wait_until = now + 3
            _auto_state = 'CREATE_DO'
            _auto_detail = 'Bayrak secildi, karakter olusturulacak'
        else:
            _auto_retry_count += 1
            _auto_wait_until = now + 2
            if _auto_retry_count > 5:
                _auto_state = 'ERROR'
                _auto_detail = 'Bayrak secilemedi'

    elif _auto_state == 'CREATE_DO':
        if _auto_create_remaining <= 0:
            _auto_state = 'SELECT_CHECK'
            _auto_detail = 'Tum karakterler olusturuldu'
            return

        chars = get_character_list()
        used_slots = set([c['slot'] for c in chars])
        empty_slots = [i for i in range(4) if i not in used_slots]

        if not empty_slots:
            _auto_state = 'ENTER_PREPARE'
            _auto_detail = 'Bos slot kalmadi'
            return

        slot = empty_slots[0]
        race = _auto_config.get('race', 3)
        empire = _auto_config.get('empire', 1)
        cname = make_random_name()

        _auto_detail = 'Karakter olusturuluyor: %s (slot %d)' % (cname, slot)
        _last_log = 'AUTO: Karakter olusturuluyor: %s' % cname

        if do_create_character(slot, cname, race, empire):
            if wait_create_result(slot, 20):
                _auto_create_done += 1
                _auto_create_remaining -= 1
                _auto_detail = 'Karakter olusturuldu: %s (%d/%d)' % (
                    cname, _auto_create_done,
                    _auto_config.get('create_count', 0))
                _auto_wait_until = now + 1
                _auto_retry_count = 0
            else:
                _auto_retry_count += 1
                _auto_detail = 'Olusturma TIMEOUT, tekrar (%d)' % _auto_retry_count
                _auto_wait_until = now + 2
                if _auto_retry_count > MAX_CREATE_RETRY:
                    _auto_create_remaining -= 1
                    _auto_retry_count = 0
                    _auto_detail = 'Olusturma basarisiz, atlandi'
        else:
            _auto_retry_count += 1
            _auto_detail = 'Olusturma hatasi, tekrar (%d)' % _auto_retry_count
            _auto_wait_until = now + 2
            if _auto_retry_count > MAX_CREATE_RETRY:
                _auto_create_remaining -= 1
                _auto_retry_count = 0

    elif _auto_state == 'ENTER_PREPARE':
        chars = get_character_list()
        if not chars:
            _auto_state = 'ERROR'
            _auto_detail = 'Karakter yok ve olusturulamadi!'
            return

        enter_name = _auto_config.get('enter_name', '')
        enter_slot = _auto_config.get('enter_slot', 0)

        target_slot = enter_slot
        if enter_name:
            found = False
            for c in chars:
                if c['name'].lower() == enter_name.lower():
                    target_slot = c['slot']
                    found = True
                    break
            if not found:
                _auto_detail = '"%s" bulunamadi, slot %d kullaniliyor' % (enter_name, enter_slot)

        valid_slots = [c['slot'] for c in chars]
        if target_slot not in valid_slots:
            target_slot = valid_slots[0]
            _auto_detail = 'Slot %d gecersiz, slot %d kullaniliyor' % (enter_slot, target_slot)

        _auto_config['_enter_slot'] = target_slot
        _auto_state = 'ENTER_GAME'

    elif _auto_state == 'ENTER_GAME':
        slot = _auto_config.get('_enter_slot', 0)
        _auto_detail = 'Oyuna giriliyor (slot %d)' % slot
        _last_error = ''
        _last_error_code = ''

        if do_enter_game(slot):
            _auto_state = 'ENTER_VERIFY'
            _auto_wait_until = now + 3
            _auto_retry_count = 0
        else:
            _auto_retry_count += 1
            _auto_wait_until = now + 2
            if _auto_retry_count > 5:
                _auto_detail = 'Giris basarisiz, sahne degistiriliyor'
                change_scene('SELECT')
                _auto_wait_until = now + 3
                _auto_retry_count = 0

    elif _auto_state == 'ENTER_VERIFY':
        detect_scene()
        if _current_scene == 'GAME':
            _auto_state = 'DONE'
            _auto_detail = 'Oyuna giris basarili!'
            _last_log = 'AUTO: Oyuna giris basarili!'
        elif _last_error_code:
            _auto_retry_count += 1
            _auto_detail = 'Giris hatasi: %s (tekrar %d)' % (_last_error, _auto_retry_count)
            if _auto_retry_count > 3:
                change_scene('SELECT')
                _auto_state = 'ENTER_GAME'
                _auto_wait_until = now + 3
                _auto_retry_count = 0
            else:
                _auto_wait_until = now + 3
        else:
            _auto_wait_until = now + 1
            _auto_retry_count += 1
            if _auto_retry_count > 30:
                _auto_state = 'ERROR'
                _auto_detail = 'Oyuna giris timeout'

    elif _auto_state == 'DONE':
        _auto_detail = 'Tamamlandi!'
        _auto_state = 'IDLE'

    elif _auto_state == 'ERROR':
        _auto_state = 'IDLE'

# ============================================================
#  ANA DONGU
# ============================================================
def main_loop():
    global _status_last_time, _last_log

    _last_log = 'MaximumPyScript baslatildi (PID: %d)' % MY_PID

    shm = SharedMemory(SHM_NAME, SHM_SIZE)
    if shm.ok:
        shm.write_magic()
        _last_log = 'SharedMemory hazir: %s' % SHM_NAME
    else:
        _last_log = 'SharedMemory ACILAMADI! mmap yok mu?'

    hook_recorder()

    try:
        print '[MAXPY] PID: %d | SHM: %s' % (MY_PID, SHM_NAME)
    except:
        pass

    try:
        f = open('C:\\maxpy_pid.txt', 'w')
        f.write('%d\n%s\n' % (MY_PID, SHM_NAME))
        f.close()
    except:
        pass

    last_cmd_time = 0.0

    while not _stop_flag[0]:
        if getattr(sys, '_maxpy_stop', False):
            break

        now = time.time()

        if shm.ok:
            cmd_data = shm.read_command()
            if cmd_data:
                try:
                    handle_command(cmd_data)
                except Exception:
                    _last_log = 'Komut hatasi'

        if _auto_state != 'IDLE':
            try:
                auto_step()
            except Exception:
                _last_log = 'AUTO hata'

        if shm.ok and now - _status_last_time >= STATUS_INTERVAL:
            _status_last_time = now
            try:
                status = build_status()
                shm.write_status(status)
            except:
                pass

        time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL)

    unhook_recorder()
    shm.close()
    sys._maxpy_running = False
    sys._maxpy_stop = False
    _last_log = 'MaximumPyScript durduruldu'

# ============================================================
#  BASLAT
# ============================================================
try:
    print '[MAXPY] MaximumPyScript v1.1 (DUZELTILMIS)'
    print '[MAXPY] PID: %d' % MY_PID
    print '[MAXPY] SharedMemory: %s' % SHM_NAME
    print '[MAXPY] External programda bu PID\'yi girin.'
except:
    pass

if HAS_THREAD:
    try:
        _thread.start_new_thread(main_loop, ())
        try:
            print '[MAXPY] Thread baslatildi'
        except:
            pass
    except:
        try:
            print '[MAXPY] Thread basarisiz, ana thread'
        except:
            pass
        main_loop()
else:
    main_loop()

// ============================================================
// Metin2 Control Center v1.0
// Win32 API External Controller
//
// Derleme (MinGW):
//   g++ -o Metin2Control.exe Metin2Control.cpp -lgdi32 -lcomctl32 -mwindows -static
//
// Derleme (MSVC):
//   cl /W3 /O2 Metin2Control.cpp /link user32.lib gdi32.lib comctl32.lib /SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS
// ============================================================
#define _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
#ifndef UNICODE
#define UNICODE
#endif
#ifndef _UNICODE
#define _UNICODE
#endif

#include <windows.h>
#include <commctrl.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment(lib, "comctl32.lib")

// ============================================================
//  SABITLER
// ============================================================
#define SHM_SIZE        65536
#define MAGIC_VAL       0x4D543243
#define STATUS_FLAG_OFF 8
#define STATUS_LEN_OFF  9
#define STATUS_DATA_OFF 13
#define CMD_FLAG_OFF    32768
#define CMD_LEN_OFF     32769
#define CMD_DATA_OFF    32773
#define CMD_DATA_MAX    (65535 - 32773)

#define TIMER_ID_POLL   1001
#define POLL_MS         300

// Control IDs
#define IDC_PID_EDIT        2001
#define IDC_BTN_CONNECT     2002
#define IDC_LBL_SCENE       2003
#define IDC_LIST_SERVER     2004
#define IDC_LIST_CHANNEL    2005
#define IDC_EDIT_USER       2006
#define IDC_EDIT_PASS       2007
#define IDC_BTN_ETAP1       2008
#define IDC_BTN_ETAP2       2009
#define IDC_LBL_CHARCOUNT   2010
#define IDC_LIST_CHARS      2011
#define IDC_BTN_ETAP3       2012
#define IDC_BTN_FLAG        2013
#define IDC_COMBO_FLAG      2014
#define IDC_EDIT_CREATECNT  2015
#define IDC_COMBO_JOB       2016
#define IDC_COMBO_GENDER    2017
#define IDC_EDIT_CHARNAME   2018
#define IDC_CHK_RANDOM      2019
#define IDC_BTN_CREATE      2020
#define IDC_BTN_ENTER       2021
#define IDC_EDIT_ENTERSLOT  2022
#define IDC_EDIT_ENTERNAME  2023
#define IDC_LOG_LIST        2024
#define IDC_BTN_AUTOALL     2025
#define IDC_BTN_SAVELOG     2026
#define IDC_BTN_STOP        2027
#define IDC_BTN_ETAP31      2028
#define IDC_STATIC          3000

// ============================================================
//  GLOBAL DEGİSKENLER
// ============================================================
static HWND g_hWnd = NULL;
static HWND g_hPidEdit, g_hBtnConnect, g_hLblScene;
static HWND g_hListServer, g_hListChannel;
static HWND g_hEditUser, g_hEditPass;
static HWND g_hBtnEtap1, g_hBtnEtap2;
static HWND g_hLblCharCount, g_hListChars;
static HWND g_hBtnEtap3, g_hBtnFlag, g_hComboFlag;
static HWND g_hEditCreateCnt, g_hComboJob, g_hComboGender;
static HWND g_hEditCharName, g_hChkRandom, g_hBtnCreate;
static HWND g_hBtnEnter, g_hEditEnterSlot, g_hEditEnterName;
static HWND g_hLogList;
static HWND g_hBtnAutoAll, g_hBtnSaveLog, g_hBtnStop, g_hBtnEtap31;

static HANDLE g_hMapFile = NULL;
static LPVOID g_pShm = NULL;
static bool g_connected = false;
static int g_targetPid = 0;

static char g_lastStatus[32768] = { 0 };
static char g_lastScene[64] = "BAGLI DEGIL";
static int g_charCount = 0;

static HFONT g_hFont = NULL;

// ============================================================
//  LOG FONKSIYONU
// ============================================================
void AddLog(const char* msg) {
    if (!g_hLogList) return;
    char buf[1024];
    SYSTEMTIME st;
    GetLocalTime(&st);
    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "[%02d:%02d:%02d] %s",
        st.wHour, st.wMinute, st.wSecond, msg);
    SendMessageA(g_hLogList, LB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)buf);
    int cnt = (int)SendMessageA(g_hLogList, LB_GETCOUNT, 0, 0);
    SendMessageA(g_hLogList, LB_SETTOPINDEX, cnt - 1, 0);
}

void AddLogW(const wchar_t* msg) {
    char buf[1024];
    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_ACP, 0, msg, -1, buf, sizeof(buf), NULL, NULL);
    AddLog(buf);
}

// ============================================================
//  SHARED MEMORY
// ============================================================
bool ShmConnect(int pid) {
    char name[64];
    snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "Control_%d", pid);

    // Once mevcut mu diye dene
    g_hMapFile = OpenFileMappingA(FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS, FALSE, name);
    if (!g_hMapFile) {
        // Olustur (Python henuz baslatmamis olabilir)
        g_hMapFile = CreateFileMappingA(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, NULL,
            PAGE_READWRITE, 0, SHM_SIZE, name);
    }
    if (!g_hMapFile) {
        AddLog("SharedMemory acilamadi!");
        return false;
    }

    g_pShm = MapViewOfFile(g_hMapFile, FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS, 0, 0, SHM_SIZE);
    if (!g_pShm) {
        CloseHandle(g_hMapFile);
        g_hMapFile = NULL;
        AddLog("SharedMemory map edilemedi!");
        return false;
    }

    // Magic kontrol
    DWORD magic = *(DWORD*)((BYTE*)g_pShm);
    if (magic != MAGIC_VAL) {
        AddLog("UYARI: Magic dogrulanamadi (Python script bekleniyor)");
    }

    g_connected = true;
    g_targetPid = pid;

    AddLog("SharedMemory baglandi: Control_");

    std::string pidstr = std::to_string(pid);
    AddLog(pidstr.c_str());

    return true;
}

void ShmDisconnect() {
    if (g_pShm) {
        UnmapViewOfFile(g_pShm);
        g_pShm = NULL;
    }
    if (g_hMapFile) {
        CloseHandle(g_hMapFile);
        g_hMapFile = NULL;
    }
    g_connected = false;
}

bool ShmReadStatus(char* out, int outSize) {
    if (!g_pShm) return false;
    BYTE* p = (BYTE*)g_pShm;
    BYTE flag = p[STATUS_FLAG_OFF];
    if (flag != 1) return false;

    DWORD len = *(DWORD*)(p + STATUS_LEN_OFF);
    if (len == 0 || len > 32000) return false;

    int copyLen = (int)len;
    if (copyLen > outSize - 1) copyLen = outSize - 1;
    memcpy(out, p + STATUS_DATA_OFF, copyLen);
    out[copyLen] = '\0';

    p[STATUS_FLAG_OFF] = 0; // okundu
    return true;
}

bool ShmWriteCommand(const char* json) {
    if (!g_pShm) return false;
    BYTE* p = (BYTE*)g_pShm;

    int len = (int)strlen(json);
    if (len > CMD_DATA_MAX) len = CMD_DATA_MAX;

    *(DWORD*)(p + CMD_LEN_OFF) = len;
    memcpy(p + CMD_DATA_OFF, json, len);
    p[CMD_FLAG_OFF] = 1;
    return true;
}

// ============================================================
//  JSON YARDIMCILARI (basit)
// ============================================================
std::string JsonGetStr(const char* json, const char* key) {
    char search[256];
    snprintf(search, sizeof(search), "\"%s\":\"", key);
    const char* pos = strstr(json, search);
    if (!pos) return "";
    pos += strlen(search);
    const char* end = strchr(pos, '"');
    if (!end) return "";
    return std::string(pos, end - pos);
}

int JsonGetInt(const char* json, const char* key) {
    char search[256];
    snprintf(search, sizeof(search), "\"%s\":", key);
    const char* pos = strstr(json, search);
    if (!pos) return -1;
    pos += strlen(search);
    // Tirnakli olabilir
    if (*pos == '"') pos++;
    return atoi(pos);
}

// ============================================================
//  KOMUT GONDERME
// ============================================================
void SendCommand(const char* json) {
    if (!g_connected) {
        AddLog("HATA: Bagli degil!");
        return;
    }
    ShmWriteCommand(json);
}

void SendLogin(int srvIdx, int chIdx, const char* user, const char* pass) {
    char buf[2048];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
        "{\"cmd\":\"LOGIN\",\"server_idx\":%d,\"ch_idx\":%d,"
        "\"username\":\"%s\",\"password\":\"%s\"}",
        srvIdx, chIdx, user, pass);
    SendCommand(buf);
    AddLog("Komut: LOGIN");
}

void SendEnterGame(int slot, const char* name) {
    char buf[1024];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
        "{\"cmd\":\"ENTER_GAME\",\"slot\":%d,\"name\":\"%s\"}",
        slot, name ? name : "");
    SendCommand(buf);
    AddLog("Komut: ENTER_GAME");
}

void SendSelectEmpire(int empire) {
    char buf[256];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
        "{\"cmd\":\"SELECT_EMPIRE\",\"empire\":%d}", empire);
    SendCommand(buf);
    AddLog("Komut: SELECT_EMPIRE");
}

void SendCreateChar(int empire, int race, const char* name, int count) {
    char buf[1024];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
        "{\"cmd\":\"CREATE_CHAR\",\"empire\":%d,\"race\":%d,"
        "\"name\":\"%s\",\"count\":%d}",
        empire, race, name ? name : "", count);
    SendCommand(buf);
    AddLog("Komut: CREATE_CHAR");
}

void SendSceneChange(const char* target) {
    char buf[256];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
        "{\"cmd\":\"SCENE_CHANGE\",\"target\":\"%s\"}", target);
    SendCommand(buf);
    AddLog("Komut: SCENE_CHANGE");
}

void SendAutoAll() {
    char user[256] = { 0 }, pass[256] = { 0 }, cname[256] = { 0 }, ename[256] = { 0 };
    GetWindowTextA(g_hEditUser, user, sizeof(user) - 1);
    GetWindowTextA(g_hEditPass, pass, sizeof(pass) - 1);
    GetWindowTextA(g_hEditCharName, cname, sizeof(cname) - 1);
    GetWindowTextA(g_hEditEnterName, ename, sizeof(ename) - 1);

    int srvIdx = 0, chIdx = 0;
    srvIdx = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListServer, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
    chIdx = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListChannel, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
    if (srvIdx == LB_ERR) srvIdx = 0;
    if (chIdx == LB_ERR) chIdx = 0;

    int createCnt = GetDlgItemInt(g_hWnd, IDC_EDIT_CREATECNT, NULL, FALSE);
    int empire = (int)SendMessageA(g_hComboFlag, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
    if (empire == CB_ERR) empire = 0;
    empire += 1; // 1=Shinsoo

    int raceIdx = (int)SendMessageA(g_hComboJob, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
    if (raceIdx == CB_ERR) raceIdx = 3;

    int enterSlot = GetDlgItemInt(g_hWnd, IDC_EDIT_ENTERSLOT, NULL, FALSE);

    char buf[4096];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
        "{\"cmd\":\"AUTO_ALL\","
        "\"server_idx\":%d,\"ch_idx\":%d,"
        "\"username\":\"%s\",\"password\":\"%s\","
        "\"create_count\":%d,\"empire\":%d,\"race\":%d,"
        "\"enter_slot\":%d,\"enter_name\":\"%s\"}",
        srvIdx, chIdx, user, pass,
        createCnt, empire, raceIdx,
        enterSlot, ename);
    SendCommand(buf);
    AddLog("Komut: AUTO ALL");
}

// ============================================================
//  DURUM ISLEME
// ============================================================
void UpdateUIFromStatus(const char* json) {
    strncpy(g_lastStatus, json, sizeof(g_lastStatus) - 1);

    // Sahne
    std::string scene = JsonGetStr(json, "scene");
    std::string sceneName = JsonGetStr(json, "scene_name");
    std::string log = JsonGetStr(json, "log");
    std::string error = JsonGetStr(json, "error");
    std::string autoState = JsonGetStr(json, "auto_state");
    std::string autoDetail = JsonGetStr(json, "auto_detail");

    snprintf(g_lastScene, sizeof(g_lastScene), "%s",
        sceneName.empty() ? scene.c_str() : sceneName.c_str());
    SetWindowTextA(g_hLblScene, g_lastScene);

    // Server listesi guncelle (degistiyse)
    int srvCount = JsonGetInt(json, "server_count");
    if (srvCount > 0) {
        int curCount = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListServer, LB_GETCOUNT, 0, 0);
        if (curCount != srvCount) {
            SendMessageA(g_hListServer, LB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < srvCount; i++) {
                char key[32];
                snprintf(key, sizeof(key), "server_%d", i);
                std::string sname = JsonGetStr(json, key);
                if (!sname.empty()) {
                    SendMessageA(g_hListServer, LB_ADDSTRING, 0,
                        (LPARAM)sname.c_str());
                }
            }
            if (srvCount > 0)
                SendMessageA(g_hListServer, LB_SETCURSEL, 0, 0);
        }
    }

    // Channel listesi
    int chCount = JsonGetInt(json, "ch_count");
    if (chCount > 0) {
        int curCount = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListChannel, LB_GETCOUNT, 0, 0);
        if (curCount != chCount) {
            SendMessageA(g_hListChannel, LB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < chCount; i++) {
                char key[32];
                snprintf(key, sizeof(key), "ch_%d", i);
                std::string cname = JsonGetStr(json, key);
                if (!cname.empty()) {
                    SendMessageA(g_hListChannel, LB_ADDSTRING, 0,
                        (LPARAM)cname.c_str());
                }
            }
            if (chCount > 0)
                SendMessageA(g_hListChannel, LB_SETCURSEL, 0, 0);
        }
    }

    // Karakter listesi
    int charCount = JsonGetInt(json, "char_count");
    g_charCount = charCount;

    char ccBuf[64];
    snprintf(ccBuf, sizeof(ccBuf), "Karakter: %d / 4", charCount);
    SetWindowTextA(g_hLblCharCount, ccBuf);

    int curCharCount = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListChars, LB_GETCOUNT, 0, 0);
    if (curCharCount != charCount) {
        SendMessageA(g_hListChars, LB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < charCount; i++) {
            char keyN[32], keyL[32], keyJ[32], keyG[32], keyS[32];
            snprintf(keyN, sizeof(keyN), "char_%d_name", i);
            snprintf(keyL, sizeof(keyL), "char_%d_level", i);
            snprintf(keyJ, sizeof(keyJ), "char_%d_job", i);
            snprintf(keyG, sizeof(keyG), "char_%d_gender", i);
            snprintf(keyS, sizeof(keyS), "char_%d_slot", i);

            std::string cn = JsonGetStr(json, keyN);
            int cl = JsonGetInt(json, keyL);
            std::string cj = JsonGetStr(json, keyJ);
            std::string cg = JsonGetStr(json, keyG);
            int cs = JsonGetInt(json, keyS);

            char item[512];
            snprintf(item, sizeof(item), "[%d] %s | Lv.%d | %s(%s)",
                cs, cn.c_str(), cl, cj.c_str(), cg.c_str());
            SendMessageA(g_hListChars, LB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)item);
        }
    }

    // Log guncelle (yeni mesaj varsa)
    static std::string lastLog;
    if (!log.empty() && log != lastLog) {
        lastLog = log;
        AddLog(log.c_str());
    }

    // Hata
    if (!error.empty()) {
        static std::string lastError;
        if (error != lastError) {
            lastError = error;
            char ebuf[512];
            snprintf(ebuf, sizeof(ebuf), "HATA: %s", error.c_str());
            AddLog(ebuf);
        }
    }

    // AUTO durum
    if (!autoState.empty() && autoState != "IDLE") {
        static std::string lastAuto;
        std::string autoStr = autoState + ": " + autoDetail;
        if (autoStr != lastAuto) {
            lastAuto = autoStr;
            char abuf[512];
            snprintf(abuf, sizeof(abuf), "[AUTO] %s", autoStr.c_str());
            AddLog(abuf);
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================
//  RAPOR KAYDET
// ============================================================
void SaveLog() {
    OPENFILENAMEA ofn = { 0 };
    char fname[MAX_PATH] = "metin2_log.txt";
    ofn.lStructSize = sizeof(ofn);
    ofn.hwndOwner = g_hWnd;
    ofn.lpstrFilter = "Text Dosyasi (*.txt)\0*.txt\0Tumu (*.*)\0*.*\0";
    ofn.lpstrFile = fname;
    ofn.nMaxFile = MAX_PATH;
    ofn.Flags = OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT;
    ofn.lpstrDefExt = "txt";

    if (!GetSaveFileNameA(&ofn)) return;

    FILE* f = fopen(fname, "w");
    if (!f) {
        AddLog("Dosya acilamadi!");
        return;
    }

    int cnt = (int)SendMessageA(g_hLogList, LB_GETCOUNT, 0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
        char buf[1024];
        SendMessageA(g_hLogList, LB_GETTEXT, i, (LPARAM)buf);
        fprintf(f, "%s\n", buf);
    }
    fclose(f);
    AddLog("Rapor kaydedildi.");
}

// ============================================================
//  TIMER CALLBACK
// ============================================================
VOID CALLBACK TimerProc(HWND, UINT, UINT_PTR, DWORD) {
    if (!g_connected) return;

    char statusBuf[32768];
    if (ShmReadStatus(statusBuf, sizeof(statusBuf))) {
        UpdateUIFromStatus(statusBuf);
    }
}

// ============================================================
//  WINDOW PROCEDURE
// ============================================================
LRESULT CALLBACK WndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    switch (msg) {

    case WM_CREATE:
        CreateUI(hWnd);
        SetTimer(hWnd, TIMER_ID_POLL, POLL_MS, TimerProc);
        AddLog("Metin2 Control Center baslatildi.");
        AddLog("Metin2 PID'sini girin ve Baglan'a basin.");
        return 0;

    case WM_COMMAND:
        switch (LOWORD(wParam)) {

        case IDC_BTN_CONNECT: {
            char pidStr[32] = { 0 };
            GetWindowTextA(g_hPidEdit, pidStr, sizeof(pidStr) - 1);
            int pid = atoi(pidStr);
            if (pid <= 0) {
                AddLog("Gecerli bir PID girin!");
                break;
            }
            if (g_connected) {
                ShmDisconnect();
            }
            if (ShmConnect(pid)) {
                AddLog("Baglanti basarili!");
            }
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_ETAP1: {
            int srv = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListServer, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            int ch = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListChannel, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (srv == LB_ERR) srv = 0;
            if (ch == LB_ERR) ch = 0;
            char buf[512];
            snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
                "ETAP1: Server=%d CH=%d secildi", srv, ch);
            AddLog(buf);
            // Server/CH secimi icin LOGIN komutunun ilk kismini gonder
            // (Login komutu server+ch+credential hepsini yapar)
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_ETAP2: {
            char user[256] = { 0 }, pass[256] = { 0 };
            GetWindowTextA(g_hEditUser, user, sizeof(user) - 1);
            GetWindowTextA(g_hEditPass, pass, sizeof(pass) - 1);
            int srv = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListServer, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            int ch = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListChannel, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (srv == LB_ERR) srv = 0;
            if (ch == LB_ERR) ch = 0;
            if (strlen(user) == 0 || strlen(pass) == 0) {
                AddLog("Kullanici adi ve sifre gerekli!");
                break;
            }
            SendLogin(srv, ch, user, pass);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_FLAG: {
            int empire = (int)SendMessageA(g_hComboFlag, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (empire == CB_ERR) empire = 0;
            empire += 1;
            SendSelectEmpire(empire);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_CREATE: {
            int empire = (int)SendMessageA(g_hComboFlag, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (empire == CB_ERR) empire = 0;
            empire += 1;
            int race = (int)SendMessageA(g_hComboJob, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (race == CB_ERR) race = 3;
            char cname[256] = { 0 };
            bool isRandom = (SendMessageA(g_hChkRandom, BM_GETCHECK, 0, 0) == BST_CHECKED);
            if (!isRandom) {
                GetWindowTextA(g_hEditCharName, cname, sizeof(cname) - 1);
            }
            int cnt = GetDlgItemInt(hWnd, IDC_EDIT_CREATECNT, NULL, FALSE);
            if (cnt < 1) cnt = 1;
            if (cnt > 4) cnt = 4;

            // Mevcut karakter sayisini kontrol et
            if (g_charCount >= 4) {
                AddLog("Zaten 4 karakter var, olusturulamaz!");
                break;
            }
            int maxCreate = 4 - g_charCount;
            if (cnt > maxCreate) {
                char wbuf[128];
                snprintf(wbuf, sizeof(wbuf),
                    "Max %d karakter olusturulabilir (mevcut: %d)",
                    maxCreate, g_charCount);
                AddLog(wbuf);
                cnt = maxCreate;
            }
            SendCreateChar(empire, race, cname, cnt);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_ETAP3:
        case IDC_BTN_ENTER: {
            int slot = GetDlgItemInt(hWnd, IDC_EDIT_ENTERSLOT, NULL, FALSE);
            char ename[256] = { 0 };
            GetWindowTextA(g_hEditEnterName, ename, sizeof(ename) - 1);
            SendEnterGame(slot, ename);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_AUTOALL: {
            if (!g_connected) {
                AddLog("Once baglanin!");
                break;
            }
            SendAutoAll();
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_ETAP31: {
            SendSceneChange("SELECT");
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_SAVELOG:
            SaveLog();
            break;

        case IDC_BTN_STOP: {
            SendCommand("{\"cmd\":\"STOP_AUTO\"}");
            AddLog("Durdurma komutu gonderildi");
            break;
        }

        } // WM_COMMAND switch
        return 0;

    case WM_TIMER:
        if (wParam == TIMER_ID_POLL) {
            // TimerProc zaten cagrilir
        }
        return 0;

    case WM_DESTROY:
        KillTimer(hWnd, TIMER_ID_POLL);
        ShmDisconnect();
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        return 0;
    }

    return DefWindowProc(hWnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
}

// ============================================================
//  WINMAIN
// ============================================================
int WINAPI WinMain(HINSTANCE hInst, HINSTANCE, LPSTR, int nCmdShow) {
    INITCOMMONCONTROLSEX icc = { sizeof(icc), ICC_LISTVIEW_CLASSES | ICC_STANDARD_CLASSES };
    InitCommonControlsEx(&icc);

    WNDCLASSEXA wc = { 0 };
    wc.cbSize = sizeof(wc);
    wc.style = CS_HREDRAW | CS_VREDRAW;
    wc.lpfnWndProc = WndProc;
    wc.hInstance = hInst;
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(NULL, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)(COLOR_BTNFACE + 1);
    wc.lpszClassName = "Metin2ControlClass";
    wc.hIcon = LoadIcon(NULL, IDI_APPLICATION);
    wc.hIconSm = LoadIcon(NULL, IDI_APPLICATION);

    if (!RegisterClassExA(&wc)) return 1;

    int winW = 455, winH = 620;
    g_hWnd = CreateWindowExA(
        0, "Metin2ControlClass",
        "Metin2 Control Center v1.0",
        WS_OVERLAPPED | WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU | WS_MINIMIZEBOX,
        CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, winW, winH,
        NULL, NULL, hInst, NULL);

    if (!g_hWnd) return 1;

    ShowWindow(g_hWnd, nCmdShow);
    UpdateWindow(g_hWnd);

    MSG msg;
    while (GetMessage(&msg, NULL, 0, 0)) {
        TranslateMessage(&msg);
        DispatchMessage(&msg);
    }

    return (int)msg.wParam;
}

# Metin2 Maximum Controller System

## Sistem Mimarisi

Bu sistem iki ana bileşenden oluşur:

1. **MaximumPyScriptx.txt** - Metin2 client içinde çalışan Python script
2. **MaximumController.cpp** - Win32 API ile yazılmış harici kontrol programı

İletişim SharedMemory üzerinden yapılır.

---

## MaximumPyScriptx.txt

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
#
# MaximumPyScriptx - Metin2 Ultimate Controller
# Kullanim: py exec(open('C:/MaximumPyScriptx.txt').read())
#

# SharedMemory boyutu
SHM_SIZE = 8192

# SharedMemory layout:
# [0..3]     = Magic (0x4D415831 = "MAX1")
# [4..7]     = Version (1)
# [8..11]    = Script -> Controller: Status code
# [12..15]   = Controller -> Script: Command code
# [16..19]   = Script PID
# [20..23]   = Scene ID
# [24..27]   = Character count
# [28..31]   = Error code
# [32..35]   = Command param1
# [36..39]   = Command param2
# [40..43]   = Command param3
# [44..47]   = Command param4
# [48..51]   = Flags (bit field)
# [52..55]   = Server count
# [56..59]   = Channel count
# [60..63]   = Selected server index
# [64..67]   = Selected channel index
# [68..71]   = Create race
# [72..75]   = Create empire
# [76..79]   = Create gender (0=default from race)
# [80..83]   = Create count (kac karakter olusturulacak)
# [84..87]   = Target slot (oyuna girilecek slot)
# [88..91]   = Auto state (AUTO ALL durumu)
# [92..95]   = Reserved
# [96..159]  = Server names (her biri 16 byte, 4 server)
# [160..223] = Channel names (her biri 16 byte, 4 channel)
# [224..287] = Character slot info (her biri 16 byte, 4 slot)
# [288..351] = Character names (her biri 16 byte, 4 slot)
# [352..415] = Create name (64 byte)
# [416..479] = Target name (oyuna girilecek isim, 64 byte)
# [480..543] = Username (64 byte)
# [544..607] = Password (64 byte)
# [608..1631]= Log ring buffer (1024 byte)
# [1632..1635] = Log write pos
# [1636..1639] = Log read pos
# [1640..4095] = Server list detail / char detail (extended)
# [4096..8191] = Reserved

MAGIC = 0x4D415831
VERSION = 1

# Offset sabitleri
OFF_MAGIC        = 0
OFF_VERSION      = 4
OFF_STATUS       = 8
OFF_COMMAND      = 12
OFF_PID          = 16
OFF_SCENE        = 20
OFF_CHAR_COUNT   = 24
OFF_ERROR        = 28
OFF_PARAM1       = 32
OFF_PARAM2       = 36
OFF_PARAM3       = 40
OFF_PARAM4       = 44
OFF_FLAGS        = 48
OFF_SRV_COUNT    = 52
OFF_CH_COUNT     = 56
OFF_SEL_SRV      = 60
OFF_SEL_CH       = 64
OFF_CR_RACE      = 68
OFF_CR_EMPIRE    = 72
OFF_CR_GENDER    = 76
OFF_CR_COUNT     = 80
OFF_TARGET_SLOT  = 84
OFF_AUTO_STATE   = 88
OFF_RESERVED1    = 92
OFF_SRV_NAMES    = 96
OFF_CH_NAMES     = 160
OFF_CHAR_INFO    = 224
OFF_CHAR_NAMES   = 288
OFF_CREATE_NAME  = 352
OFF_TARGET_NAME  = 416
OFF_USERNAME     = 480
OFF_PASSWORD     = 544
OFF_LOG_BUF      = 608
OFF_LOG_WPOS     = 1632
OFF_LOG_RPOS     = 1636
OFF_EXTENDED     = 1640

# Status codes (Script -> Controller)
ST_IDLE          = 0
```
