# ============================================================
#  YARDIMCI FONKSIYONLAR
# ============================================================

def safe_str(v):
    if v is None:
        return ''
    if isinstance(v, str):
        return v
    if isinstance(v, unicode):
        for enc in ('cp1254', 'utf-8', 'latin-1'):
            try:
                return v.encode(enc)
            except:
                pass
        try:
            return v.encode('ascii', 'replace')
        except:
            return repr(v)
    try:
        return str(v)
    except:
        return '???'

def clean_text(v):
    s = safe_str(v)
    s = s.replace('\r', ' ').replace('\n', ' ')
    s = ' '.join(s.split())
    return s.strip()

def append_log(msg):
    s = safe_str(msg)
    ts = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    line = '[%s] %s' % (ts, s)
    try:
        f = open(LOG_FILE, 'a')
        f.write(line + '\n')
        f.close()
    except:
        pass
    try:
        print '[MAX] ' + s
    except:
        pass
    return line

def make_random_name():
    try:
        import random as _r
        _r.seed(int(time.time() * 1000) % 999999)
        pre = ['Ael', 'Zar', 'Kri', 'Myr', 'Vel', 'Xan', 'Dra', 'Fio', 'Lun', 'Ren',
               'Syl', 'Tyr', 'Vor', 'Ash', 'Bri', 'Cel', 'Dor', 'Eri', 'Fae', 'Gor']
        mid = ['ma', 'ri', 'lo', 'na', 'ke', 'si', 'da', 've', 'el', 'or',
               'in', 'ar', 'la', 'en', 'mi', 'ro', 'li', 'ta', 'ka', 'ze']
        suf = ['a', 'is', 'on', 'ia', 'el', 'ra', 'yn', 'ne', 'da', 'la']
        nm = _r.choice(pre) + _r.choice(mid) + _r.choice(suf) + str(_r.randint(10, 999))
        if len(nm) > 16:
            nm = nm[:16]
        return nm[0].upper() + nm[1:].lower()
    except:
        seed = int(time.time() * 1000) % 999999
        chars = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
        nm = ''
        v = seed
        for k in range(8):
            v = (v * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483647
            nm = nm + chars[v % 26]
        v2 = (v * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483647
        nm = nm + str(v2 % 900 + 100)
        return nm[0].upper() + nm[1:]

# ============================================================
#  LOCALE REVERSE MAP
# ============================================================
locale_reverse = {}

def build_locale_reverse():
    global locale_reverse
    locale_mod = None
    for mn in ('localeInfo', 'locale_info', 'uiScriptLocale'):
        m = sys.modules.get(mn, None)
        if m:
            locale_mod = m
            break
    if not locale_mod:
        return 0
    count = 0
    str_vars = {}
    for name in dir(locale_mod):
        if name.startswith('_'):
            continue
        try:
            val = getattr(locale_mod, name)
        except:
            continue
        if callable(val):
            continue
        if isinstance(val, str) or isinstance(val, unicode):
            s = clean_text(val)
            if s and len(s) >= 1:
                str_vars[name] = s
                count += 1
    val_to_keys = {}
    for k, v in str_vars.items():
        if v not in val_to_keys:
            val_to_keys[v] = []
        val_to_keys[v].append(k)
    locale_reverse.clear()
    for v, keys in val_to_keys.items():
        prio = None
        for k in keys:
            kl = k.upper()
            if any(x in kl for x in ('LOGIN', 'UI_', 'CONNECT', 'REFINE', 'DELETE',
                                      'SELECT', 'DRAGON_SOUL', 'CANNOT', 'FAILURE',
                                      'SUCCESS', 'ALREADY')):
                prio = k
                break
        locale_reverse[v] = prio if prio else keys[0]
    return count

def lookup_locale_key(text):
    s = clean_text(text)
    if not s:
        return None
    return locale_reverse.get(s, None)

def get_locale_text(locale_var):
    for val, key in locale_reverse.items():
        if key == locale_var:
            return val
    return None

# ============================================================
#  SHARED MEMORY MANAGER
# ============================================================

class SharedMemoryManager(object):
    def __init__(self):
        self.shm = None
        self.shm_name = ''
        self.ready = False

    def create(self):
        pid = os.getpid()
        self.shm_name = 'Control_%d' % pid
        try:
            if has_mmap:
                self.shm = mmap.mmap(-1, SHM_SIZE, self.shm_name)
                self.shm.seek(0)
                self.shm.write(b'\x00' * SHM_SIZE)
                # Magic + Version + PID
                self._write_u32(OFF_MAGIC, MAGIC)
                self._write_u32(OFF_VERSION, VERSION)
                self._write_u32(OFF_PID, pid)
                self._write_u32(OFF_STATUS, ST_IDLE)
                self._write_u32(OFF_COMMAND, CMD_NONE)
                self._write_u32(OFF_ERROR, ERR_NONE)
                self._write_u32(OFF_LOG_WPOS, 0)
                self._write_u32(OFF_LOG_RPOS, 0)
                self.ready = True
                append_log('SharedMemory olusturuldu: %s (PID=%d)' % (self.shm_name, pid))
                return True
            elif has_ctypes:
                # ctypes ile CreateFileMappingA
                kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
                INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE = ctypes.c_void_p(-1).value
                PAGE_READWRITE = 0x04
                FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS = 0xF001F

                hMap = kernel32.CreateFileMappingA(
                    INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, None, PAGE_READWRITE,
                    0, SHM_SIZE, self.shm_name.encode('ascii'))
                if not hMap:
                    append_log('CreateFileMapping HATA!')
                    return False
                self._hMap = hMap
                pBuf = kernel32.MapViewOfFile(hMap, FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS, 0, 0, SHM_SIZE)
                if not pBuf:
                    append_log('MapViewOfFile HATA!')
                    return False
                self._pBuf = pBuf
                # ctypes raw memory
                ctypes.memset(pBuf, 0, SHM_SIZE)
                self._ctypes_write_u32(OFF_MAGIC, MAGIC)
                self._ctypes_write_u32(OFF_VERSION, VERSION)
                self._ctypes_write_u32(OFF_PID, pid)
                self._ctypes_write_u32(OFF_STATUS, ST_IDLE)
                self._ctypes_write_u32(OFF_COMMAND, CMD_NONE)
                self._ctypes_write_u32(OFF_ERROR, ERR_NONE)
                self._ctypes_write_u32(OFF_LOG_WPOS, 0)
                self._ctypes_write_u32(OFF_LOG_RPOS, 0)
                self.ready = True
                append_log('SharedMemory (ctypes) olusturuldu: %s (PID=%d)' % (self.shm_name, pid))
                return True
            else:
                append_log('SharedMemory olusturulamadi: ne mmap ne ctypes var!')
                return False
        except Exception:
            try:
                append_log('SharedMemory HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))
            except:
                pass
            return False

    # --- mmap okuma/yazma ---
    def _write_u32(self, offset, value):
        if self.shm:
            self.shm.seek(offset)
            self.shm.write(struct.pack('<I', value & 0xFFFFFFFF))

    def _read_u32(self, offset):
        if self.shm:
            self.shm.seek(offset)
            data = self.shm.read(4)
            if len(data) == 4:
                return struct.unpack('<I', data)[0]
        return 0

    def _write_str(self, offset, s, max_len):
        if self.shm:
            bs = safe_str(s)
            if isinstance(bs, unicode):
                bs = bs.encode('utf-8', 'replace')
            if len(bs) >= max_len:
                bs = bs[:max_len - 1]
            bs = bs + b'\x00' * (max_len - len(bs))
            self.shm.seek(offset)
            self.shm.write(bs[:max_len])

    def _read_str(self, offset, max_len):
        if self.shm:
            self.shm.seek(offset)
            data = self.shm.read(max_len)
            idx = data.find(b'\x00')
            if idx >= 0:
                data = data[:idx]
            try:
                return data.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
            except:
                return str(data)
        return ''

    # --- ctypes okuma/yazma ---
    def _ctypes_write_u32(self, offset, value):
        if hasattr(self, '_pBuf'):
            ctypes.c_uint32.from_address(self._pBuf + offset).value = value & 0xFFFFFFFF

    def _ctypes_read_u32(self, offset):
        if hasattr(self, '_pBuf'):
            return ctypes.c_uint32.from_address(self._pBuf + offset).value
        return 0

    def _ctypes_write_str(self, offset, s, max_len):
        if hasattr(self, '_pBuf'):
            bs = safe_str(s)
            if isinstance(bs, unicode):
                bs = bs.encode('utf-8', 'replace')
            if len(bs) >= max_len:
                bs = bs[:max_len - 1]
            bs = bs + b'\x00' * (max_len - len(bs))
            ctypes.memmove(self._pBuf + offset, bs[:max_len], max_len)

    def _ctypes_read_str(self, offset, max_len):
        if hasattr(self, '_pBuf'):
            buf = (ctypes.c_char * max_len).from_address(self._pBuf + offset)
            data = bytes(buf)
            idx = data.find(b'\x00')
            if idx >= 0:
                data = data[:idx]
            try:
                return data.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
            except:
                return str(data)
        return ''

    # --- Unified read/write ---
    def write_u32(self, offset, value):
        if self.shm:
            self._write_u32(offset, value)
        elif hasattr(self, '_pBuf'):
            self._ctypes_write_u32(offset, value)

    def read_u32(self, offset):
        if self.shm:
            return self._read_u32(offset)
        elif hasattr(self, '_pBuf'):
            return self._ctypes_read_u32(offset)
        return 0

    def write_str(self, offset, s, max_len):
        if self.shm:
            self._write_str(offset, s, max_len)
        elif hasattr(self, '_pBuf'):
            self._ctypes_write_str(offset, s, max_len)

    def read_str(self, offset, max_len):
        if self.shm:
            return self._read_str(offset, max_len)
        elif hasattr(self, '_pBuf'):
            return self._ctypes_read_str(offset, max_len)
        return ''

    # --- Status/Command ---
    def set_status(self, status):
        self.write_u32(OFF_STATUS, status)

    def get_status(self):
        return self.read_u32(OFF_STATUS)

    def get_command(self):
        return self.read_u32(OFF_COMMAND)

    def clear_command(self):
        self.write_u32(OFF_COMMAND, CMD_NONE)

    def set_error(self, err):
        self.write_u32(OFF_ERROR, err)

    def get_error(self):
        return self.read_u32(OFF_ERROR)

    def set_scene(self, scene_id):
        self.write_u32(OFF_SCENE, scene_id)

    def get_scene(self):
        return self.read_u32(OFF_SCENE)

    def set_char_count(self, count):
        self.write_u32(OFF_CHAR_COUNT, count)

    def set_flags(self, flags):
        self.write_u32(OFF_FLAGS, flags)

    def get_flags(self):
        return self.read_u32(OFF_FLAGS)

    def get_param(self, n):
        return self.read_u32(OFF_PARAM1 + (n - 1) * 4)

    # --- Log ring buffer ---
    def write_log(self, msg):
        s = safe_str(msg)
        ts = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
        line = '[%s] %s' % (ts, s)
        if isinstance(line, unicode):
            line = line.encode('utf-8', 'replace')
        line = line[:200]  # max 200 byte per msg
        line_with_len = struct.pack('<H', len(line)) + line
        buf_size = 1024
        wpos = self.read_u32(OFF_LOG_WPOS)
        for b in line_with_len:
            if isinstance(b, int):
                bv = b
            else:
                bv = ord(b)
            actual_off = OFF_LOG_BUF + (wpos % buf_size)
            if self.shm:
                self.shm.seek(actual_off)
                self.shm.write(struct.pack('B', bv))
            elif hasattr(self, '_pBuf'):
                ctypes.c_ubyte.from_address(self._pBuf + actual_off).value = bv
            wpos += 1
        self.write_u32(OFF_LOG_WPOS, wpos)

    # --- Server/Channel bilgileri ---
    def write_server_name(self, idx, name):
        if idx < 0 or idx >= 4:
            return
        self.write_str(OFF_SRV_NAMES + idx * 16, name, 16)

    def write_channel_name(self, idx, name):
        if idx < 0 or idx >= 4:
            return
        self.write_str(OFF_CH_NAMES + idx * 16, name, 16)

    # --- Character bilgileri ---
    def write_char_info(self, slot, race, level, flags):
        if slot < 0 or slot >= 4:
            return
        off = OFF_CHAR_INFO + slot * 16
        self.write_u32(off, race)
        self.write_u32(off + 4, level)
        self.write_u32(off + 8, flags)
        self.write_u32(off + 12, 0)

    def write_char_name(self, slot, name):
        if slot < 0 or slot >= 4:
            return
        self.write_str(OFF_CHAR_NAMES + slot * 16, name, 16)

    def close(self):
        try:
            if self.shm:
                self.shm.close()
                self.shm = None
        except:
            pass
        try:
            if hasattr(self, '_pBuf') and hasattr(self, '_hMap'):
                kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
                kernel32.UnmapViewOfFile(self._pBuf)
                kernel32.CloseHandle(self._hMap)
                del self._pBuf
                del self._hMap
        except:
            pass
        self.ready = False


# ============================================================
#  RECORDER (minimal - hata yakalama icin)
# ============================================================

class Recorder(object):
    def __init__(self, shm_mgr):
        self.shm = shm_mgr
        self.hooked = False
        self.login_result = {'status': '', 'error': '', 'msg': ''}
        self.locale_count = 0
        self._orig_methods = {}

    def setup(self):
        self.locale_count = build_locale_reverse()
        self._hook_chat()
        self._hook_login_callbacks()
        self.hooked = True
        self._log('Recorder kuruldu: %d locale' % self.locale_count)

    def _log(self, msg):
        line = append_log(msg)
        if self.shm and self.shm.ready:
            self.shm.write_log(msg)

    def record_event(self, event_type, detail, text=None):
        ts = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
        parts = ['[%s]' % ts, '[%s:%s]' % (event_type, safe_str(detail))]
        if text:
            s = clean_text(text)
            if s:
                lk = lookup_locale_key(s)
                if lk:
                    parts.append('[localeInfo.%s]' % lk)
                parts.append(s)
        line = ' '.join(parts)
        try:
            f = open(RESULT_FILE, 'a')
            f.write(line + '\n')
            f.close()
        except:
            pass
        try:
            print '[REC] ' + line
        except:
            pass
        if self.shm and self.shm.ready:
            self.shm.write_log(line)

    def _hook_chat(self):
        if not chat_mod or not hasattr(chat_mod, 'AppendChat'):
            return
        orig = chat_mod.AppendChat
        if getattr(orig, '_max_hook', False):
            return
        self._orig_methods['chat.AppendChat'] = orig
        recorder_ref = self

        def _hooked(chat_type, msg, *args):
            try:
                s = clean_text(msg)
                if s and len(s) >= 2 and '[max]' not in s.lower():
                    type_names = {
                        0: 'NORMAL', 1: 'WHISPER', 2: 'INFO', 3: 'PARTY',
                        4: 'GUILD', 5: 'COMMAND', 6: 'SHOUT', 7: 'NOTICE',
                        8: 'GLOBAL', 9: 'SYSTEM', 10: 'EMPIRE',
                    }
                    tn = type_names.get(chat_type, str(chat_type))
                    recorder_ref.record_event('CHAT', tn, s)
            except:
                pass
            return orig(chat_type, msg, *args)
        _hooked._max_hook = True
        chat_mod.AppendChat = _hooked

    def _hook_login_callbacks(self):
        # Login window hook'lari lazy yapilir (sahne tespitinde)
        pass

    def hook_login_window(self, lw):
        if not lw:
            return
        recorder_ref = self

        # OnLoginFailure
        if hasattr(lw, 'OnLoginFailure') and not getattr(lw.OnLoginFailure, '_max_hook', False):
            orig = lw.OnLoginFailure
            ERROR_TO_LOCALE = {
                'ALREADY': 'LOGIN_FAILURE_ALREAY',
                'NOID': 'LOGIN_FAILURE_NOT_EXIST_ID',
                'WRONGPWD': 'LOGIN_FAILURE_WRONG_PASSWORD',
                'FULL': 'LOGIN_FAILURE_TOO_MANY_USER',
                'SHUTDOWN': 'LOGIN_FAILURE_SHUTDOWN',
                'REPAIR': 'LOGIN_FAILURE_REPAIR_ID',
                'BLOCK': 'LOGIN_FAILURE_BLOCK_ID',
            }

            def _h(error, _o=orig):
                try:
                    es = safe_str(error)
                    lv = ERROR_TO_LOCALE.get(es, 'LOGIN_FAILURE_UNKNOWN')
                    rt = get_locale_text(lv)
                    if not rt and hasattr(lw, 'loginFailureMsgDict'):
                        try:
                            rt = lw.loginFailureMsgDict.get(es, None)
                        except:
                            pass
                    recorder_ref.login_result['status'] = 'FAILED'
                    recorder_ref.login_result['error'] = es
                    recorder_ref.login_result['msg'] = safe_str(rt) if rt else es
                    recorder_ref.record_event('LOGIN_FAILURE', es, rt)
                except:
                    pass
                return _o(error)
            _h._max_hook = True
            lw.OnLoginFailure = _h
            self._log('LoginWindow.OnLoginFailure hooked')

        # OnConnectFailure
        if hasattr(lw, 'OnConnectFailure') and not getattr(lw.OnConnectFailure, '_max_hook', False):
            orig = lw.OnConnectFailure

            def _h(_o=orig):
                try:
                    lt = get_locale_text('LOGIN_CONNECT_FAILURE')
                    recorder_ref.login_result['status'] = 'CONNECT_FAILED'
                    recorder_ref.login_result['msg'] = safe_str(lt) if lt else 'Connect failed'
                    recorder_ref.record_event('CONNECT_FAILURE', 'FAIL', lt)
                except:
                    pass
                return _o()
            _h._max_hook = True
            lw.OnConnectFailure = _h
            self._log('LoginWindow.OnConnectFailure hooked')

        # OnHandShake
        if hasattr(lw, 'OnHandShake') and not getattr(lw.OnHandShake, '_max_hook', False):
            orig = lw.OnHandShake

            def _h(_o=orig):
                try:
                    recorder_ref.login_result['status'] = 'HANDSHAKE'
                    recorder_ref.record_event('HANDSHAKE', 'OK', None)
                except:
                    pass
                return _o()
            _h._max_hook = True
            lw.OnHandShake = _h
            self._log('LoginWindow.OnHandShake hooked')

    def hook_select_window(self, sw):
        if not sw:
            return
        recorder_ref = self

        for mname in ('OnDeleteFailure', 'OnDeleteSuccess', 'OnCreateFailure', 'OnCreateSuccess'):
            if hasattr(sw, mname) and not getattr(getattr(sw, mname), '_max_hook', False):
                orig = getattr(sw, mname)

                def _make_h(o, mn):
                    def _h(*args):
                        try:
                            recorder_ref.record_event('CHAR_SELECT', mn, None)
                        except:
                            pass
                        return o(*args)
                    _h._max_hook = True
                    return _h
                setattr(sw, mname, _make_h(orig, mname))

    def restore(self):
        for key, orig in self._orig_methods.items():
            parts = key.split('.')
            if len(parts) == 2:
                mod = sys.modules.get(parts[0], None)
                if mod:
                    try:
                        setattr(mod, parts[1], orig)
                    except:
                        pass


# ============================================================
#  SCENE DETECTOR
# ============================================================

class SceneDetector(object):
    def __init__(self):
        self.current_scene = SCENE_UNKNOWN
        self._cache = {}
        self._last_detect = 0

    def detect(self):
        now = time.time()
        if now - self._last_detect < 0.3:
            return self.current_scene
        self._last_detect = now

        # MainStream kontrol
        stm = self._find_object('MainStream')

        # 1. LoginWindow gorunur mu?
        lw = self._find_object('LoginWindow')
        if lw:
            try:
                # serverBoard gorunur mu?
                sb = getattr(lw, 'serverBoard', None)
                if sb and sb.IsShow():
                    self.current_scene = SCENE_SERVER_SEL
                    return self.current_scene
                # loginBoard gorunur mu?
                lb = getattr(lw, 'loginBoard', None)
                if lb and lb.IsShow():
                    self.current_scene = SCENE_LOGIN
                    return self.current_scene
                # connectingDialog gorunur mu?
                cd = getattr(lw, 'connectingDialog', None)
                if cd and hasattr(cd, 'IsShow') and cd.IsShow():
                    self.current_scene = SCENE_LOGIN
                    return self.current_scene
            except:
                pass

        # 2. Empire secim ekrani
        ew = self._find_object('ReselectEmpireWindow')
        if not ew:
            ew = self._find_object('SelectEmpireWindow')
        if ew:
            try:
                if ew.IsShow():
                    self.current_scene = SCENE_EMPIRE_SEL
                    return self.current_scene
            except:
                pass

        # 3. Karakter secim ekrani
        sw = self._find_object('SelectCharacterWindow')
        if sw:
            try:
                if sw.IsShow():
                    # nameInputBoard var mi? (karakter olusturma modunda mi?)
                    nib = getattr(sw, 'nameInputBoard', None)
                    if nib is not None:
                        try:
                            if nib.IsShow():
                                self.current_scene = SCENE_CHAR_CREATE
                                return self.current_scene
                        except:
                            self.current_scene = SCENE_CHAR_CREATE
                            return self.current_scene
                    self.current_scene = SCENE_CHAR_SEL
                    return self.current_scene
            except:
                pass

        # 4. Oyun icinde mi?
        try:
            if net_mod and net_mod.IsConnect():
                # game modulu yuklendi mi?
                game = sys.modules.get('game', None) or sys.modules.get('introGame', None)
                if game:
                    self.current_scene = SCENE_GAME
                    return self.current_scene
                # Loading olabilir
                self.current_scene = SCENE_LOADING
                return self.current_scene
        except:
            pass

        self.current_scene = SCENE_UNKNOWN
        return self.current_scene

    def _find_object(self, class_name):
        # Cache'den kontrol
        cached = self._cache.get(class_name, None)
        if cached is not None:
            try:
                # Hala gecerli mi?
                _ = type(cached).__name__
                return cached
            except:
                self._cache[class_name] = None

        # gc ile ara
        try:
            for obj in gc.get_objects():
                if type(obj).__name__ == class_name:
                    self._cache[class_name] = obj
                    return obj
        except:
            pass
        return None

    def get_login_window(self):
        return self._find_object('LoginWindow')

    def get_select_window(self):
        return self._find_object('SelectCharacterWindow')

    def get_empire_window(self):
        w = self._find_object('ReselectEmpireWindow')
        if not w:
            w = self._find_object('SelectEmpireWindow')
        return w

    def get_stream(self):
        return self._find_object('MainStream')

    def invalidate(self):
        self._cache.clear()
        self._last_detect = 0


# ============================================================
#  CHARACTER MANAGER
# ============================================================

class CharacterManager(object):
    def __init__(self, shm_mgr, recorder, scene_detector):
        self.shm = shm_mgr
        self.rec = recorder
        self.sd = scene_detector
        self.characters = []
        self.empty_slots = []
        self.char_count = 0

    def refresh(self):
        self.characters = []
        self.empty_slots = []
        if not net_mod:
            return
        for i in range(4):
            char_id = 0
            try:
                char_id = net_mod.GetAccountCharacterSlotDataInteger(i, SLOT_ID)
            except:
                pass
            if char_id == 0:
                self.empty_slots.append(i)
                if self.shm.ready:
                    self.shm.write_char_name(i, '')
                    self.shm.write_char_info(i, 0, 0, 0)
                continue
            name = '?'
            try:
                name = net_mod.GetAccountCharacterSlotDataString(i, SLOT_NAME)
            except:
                pass
            race = 0
            try:
                race = net_mod.GetAccountCharacterSlotDataInteger(i, SLOT_RACE)
            except:
                pass
            level = 0
            try:
                level = net_mod.GetAccountCharacterSlotDataInteger(i, SLOT_LEVEL)
            except:
                pass
            self.characters.append({
                'slot': i, 'id': char_id, 'name': safe_str(name),
                'race': race, 'level': level,
                'job': JOB_NAMES.get(race, '?'),
                'gender': GENDER_NAMES.get(race, '?'),
            })
            if self.shm.ready:
                self.shm.write_char_name(i, safe_str(name))
                self.shm.write_char_info(i, race, level, 1)
        self.char_count = len(self.characters)
        if self.shm.ready:
            self.shm.set_char_count(self.char_count)
        self.rec.record_event('CHAR_REFRESH', 'count=%d empty=%d' % (self.char_count, len(self.empty_slots)), None)

    def find_by_name(self, name):
        name_lower = safe_str(name).lower()
        for c in self.characters:
            if c['name'].lower() == name_lower:
                return c
        return None

    def find_by_slot(self, slot):
        for c in self.characters:
            if c['slot'] == slot:
                return c
        return None

    def get_next_empty_slot(self):
        if self.empty_slots:
            return self.empty_slots[0]
        return -1


# ============================================================
#  ACTION EXECUTOR
# ============================================================

class ActionExecutor(object):
    def __init__(self, shm_mgr, recorder, scene_detector, char_mgr):
        self.shm = shm_mgr
        self.rec = recorder
        self.sd = scene_detector
        self.cm = char_mgr
        self._retry_count = {}

    def _log(self, msg):
        line = append_log(msg)
        if self.shm.ready:
            self.shm.write_log(msg)

    def _wait(self, seconds):
        time.sleep(seconds)

    def _wait_for_scene(self, target_scene, timeout=15):
        start = time.time()
        while time.time() - start < timeout:
            self.sd.invalidate()
            scene = self.sd.detect()
            if self.shm.ready:
                self.shm.set_scene(scene)
            if scene == target_scene:
                return True
            self._wait(0.5)
        return False

    def _wait_for_any_scene(self, target_scenes, timeout=15):
        start = time.time()
        while time.time() - start < timeout:
            self.sd.invalidate()
            scene = self.sd.detect()
            if self.shm.ready:
                self.shm.set_scene(scene)
            if scene in target_scenes:
                return scene
            self._wait(0.5)
        return SCENE_UNKNOWN

    # -------- SERVER/CH SECIMI --------
    def do_select_server(self, srv_idx, ch_idx):
        self._log('Server/CH secimi: srv=%d ch=%d' % (srv_idx, ch_idx))
        self.shm.set_status(ST_AT_SERVER_SEL)

        lw = self.sd.get_login_window()
        if not lw:
            self._log('LoginWindow bulunamadi!')
            self.shm.set_error(ERR_UNKNOWN)
            return False

        # Server listesi bilgilerini SHM'ye yaz
        try:
            sl = lw.serverList
            sl_count = sl.GetItemCount()
            self.shm.write_u32(OFF_SRV_COUNT, sl_count)
            for i in range(min(sl_count, 4)):
                try:
                    txt = sl.GetItemText(i)
                    self.shm.write_server_name(i, safe_str(txt))
                except:
                    pass
        except:
            pass

        try:
            cl = lw.channelList
            cl_count = cl.GetItemCount()
            self.shm.write_u32(OFF_CH_COUNT, cl_count)
            for i in range(min(cl_count, 4)):
                try:
                    txt = cl.GetItemText(i)
                    self.shm.write_channel_name(i, safe_str(txt))
                except:
                    pass
        except:
            pass

        # Server sec
        try:
            lw.serverList.SelectItem(srv_idx)
            self._log('Server SelectItem(%d) OK' % srv_idx)
        except Exception:
            self._log('Server SelectItem HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))

        # Channel sec
        try:
            lw.channelList.SelectItem(ch_idx)
            self._log('Channel SelectItem(%d) OK' % ch_idx)
        except Exception:
            self._log('Channel SelectItem HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))

        # OK butonu
        try:
            lw.serverSelectButton.CallEvent()
            self._log('serverSelectButton OK')
        except Exception:
            self._log('serverSelectButton HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))

        self.shm.write_u32(OFF_SEL_SRV, srv_idx)
        self.shm.write_u32(OFF_SEL_CH, ch_idx)
        self.rec.record_event('SERVER_SELECT', 'srv=%d ch=%d' % (srv_idx, ch_idx), None)

        # Login ekranina gecmesini bekle
        self._wait(1.0)
        return True

    # -------- LOGIN --------
    def do_login(self, username, password):
        self._log('Login: %s / ****' % username)
        self.shm.set_status(ST_LOGGING_IN)
        self.rec.login_result = {'status': '', 'error': '', 'msg': ''}

        lw = self.sd.get_login_window()
        if not lw:
            self._log('LoginWindow bulunamadi!')
            self.shm.set_status(ST_LOGIN_FAIL)
            self.shm.set_error(ERR_UNKNOWN)
            return False

        # Recorder hook'larini kur
        self.rec.hook_login_window(lw)

        # Username
        try:
            lw.idEditLine.SetText(username)
            self._log('Username set OK')
        except Exception:
            self._log('Username HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))
            self.shm.set_status(ST_LOGIN_FAIL)
            return False

        # Password
        try:
            lw.pwdEditLine.SetText(password)
            self._log('Password set OK')
        except Exception:
            self._log('Password HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))
            self.shm.set_status(ST_LOGIN_FAIL)
            return False

        # Login butonu
        try:
            lw.loginButton.CallEvent()
            self._log('loginButton OK')
        except Exception:
            self._log('loginButton HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))
            self.shm.set_status(ST_LOGIN_FAIL)
            return False

        self.rec.record_event('LOGIN_ATTEMPT', username, None)

        # Sonuc bekle
        self._log('Login sonucu bekleniyor (30s)...')
        start = time.time()
        while time.time() - start < 30:
            self._wait(0.3)

            # Recorder hook sonucu kontrol
            rs = self.rec.login_result.get('status', '')
            if rs == 'FAILED':
                err_msg = self.rec.login_result.get('msg', '')
                self._log('LOGIN BASARISIZ: %s' % err_msg)
                self.shm.set_status(ST_LOGIN_FAIL)
                self.shm.set_error(ERR_LOGIN_FAIL)
                return False
            if rs == 'CONNECT_FAILED':
                err_msg = self.rec.login_result.get('msg', '')
                self._log('BAGLANTI HATASI: %s' % err_msg)
                self.shm.set_status(ST_CONNECT_FAIL)
                self.shm.set_error(ERR_CONNECT_FAIL)
                return False

            # Sahne degisti mi?
            self.sd.invalidate()
            scene = self.sd.detect()
            self.shm.set_scene(scene)

            if scene == SCENE_CHAR_SEL:
                self._log('LOGIN BASARILI - Karakter secim ekranina gecildi')
                self.shm.set_status(ST_LOGIN_OK)
                self.shm.set_error(ERR_NONE)
                self.rec.record_event('LOGIN_SUCCESS', 'OK', None)
                return True

            if scene == SCENE_EMPIRE_SEL:
                self._log('LOGIN BASARILI - Empire secim ekranina gecildi')
                self.shm.set_status(ST_LOGIN_OK)
                self.shm.set_error(ERR_NONE)
                self.rec.record_event('LOGIN_SUCCESS', 'EMPIRE_SEL', None)
                return True

            # isStartError kontrol
            try:
                if lw.isStartError:
                    self._log('LOGIN HATA: isStartError')
                    self.shm.set_status(ST_LOGIN_FAIL)
                    self.shm.set_error(ERR_LOGIN_FAIL)
                    return False
            except:
                pass

        self._log('LOGIN TIMEOUT')
        self.shm.set_status(ST_LOGIN_FAIL)
        self.shm.set_error(ERR_TIMEOUT)
        return False

    # -------- EMPIRE SECIMI --------
    def do_select_empire(self, empire_id):
        self._log('Empire secimi: %d (%s)' % (empire_id, EMPIRE_NAMES.get(empire_id, '?')))
        self.shm.set_status(ST_AT_EMPIRE_SEL)

        ew = self.sd.get_empire_window()
        if not ew:
            self._log('Empire window bulunamadi!')
            # Paket ile dene
            try:
                net_mod.SendSelectEmpirePacket(empire_id)
                self._log('PAKET: SendSelectEmpirePacket(%d) OK' % empire_id)
                self._wait(3)
                self.shm.set_status(ST_EMPIRE_DONE)
                return True
            except Exception:
                self._log('Empire HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))
                return False

        # Yontem A: UI
        try:
            ew.OnSelectEmpire(empire_id)
            self._log('OnSelectEmpire(%d) OK' % empire_id)
            self._wait(0.5)
        except Exception:
            self._log('OnSelectEmpire HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))

        # empireID set
        try:
            ew.empireID = empire_id
        except:
            pass

        # ClickSelectButton
        try:
            ew.ClickSelectButton()
            self._log('ClickSelectButton OK')
            self._wait(2)
        except Exception:
            self._log('ClickSelectButton HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))
            # ElementDictionary
            try:
                ed = getattr(ew, 'ElementDictionary', None)
                if ed:
                    sb = ed.get('select_button', None)
                    if sb and hasattr(sb, 'CallEvent'):
                        sb.CallEvent()
                        self._log('select_button.CallEvent OK')
                        self._wait(2)
            except:
                pass

        # Paket fallback
        try:
            net_mod.SendSelectEmpirePacket(empire_id)
            self._log('PAKET fallback: SendSelectEmpirePacket(%d)' % empire_id)
            self._wait(3)
        except:
            pass

        # Sahne degisimini bekle
        result_scene = self._wait_for_any_scene(
            [SCENE_CHAR_SEL, SCENE_CHAR_CREATE],
            timeout=10
        )
        if result_scene != SCENE_UNKNOWN:
            self._log('Empire sonrasi sahne: %d' % result_scene)
            self.shm.set_status(ST_EMPIRE_DONE)
            self.rec.record_event('EMPIRE_SELECT', 'empire=%d' % empire_id, None)
            return True

        self._log('Empire sonrasi sahne degismedi!')
        self.shm.set_status(ST_EMPIRE_DONE)
        return True  # Devam et, belki karakter olusturma gelir

    # -------- KARAKTER OLUSTURMA --------
    def do_create_character(self, race, empire, name=None, slot=-1):
        if name is None or name == '':
            name = make_random_name()

        if slot < 0:
            slot = self.cm.get_next_empty_slot()
            if slot < 0:
                self._log('Bos slot yok!')
                return False

        self._log('Karakter olusturma: slot=%d name=%s race=%d empire=%d' % (slot, name, race, empire))
        self.shm.set_status(ST_CREATING_CHAR)

        pre_count = self.cm.char_count

        # YONTEM 1: Paket
        try:
            use_empire = empire
            try:
                eid = net_mod.GetEmpireID()
                if eid > 0:
                    use_empire = eid
            except:
                pass

            net_mod.SendCreateCharacterPacket(slot, name, race, use_empire)
            self._log('SendCreateCharacterPacket OK')
            self.rec.record_event('CREATE_CHAR', 'slot=%d name=%s race=%d' % (slot, name, race), None)
        except Exception:
            self._log('SendCreateCharacterPacket HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))

            # YONTEM 2: UI
            sw = self.sd.get_select_window()
            if sw:
                try:
                    # MakeCharacter
                    if hasattr(sw, 'MakeCharacter'):
                        sw.MakeCharacter()
                        self._log('MakeCharacter OK')
                        self._wait(1)

                    # Empire secimine gitmis olabilir
                    self.sd.invalidate()
                    scene = self.sd.detect()
                    if scene == SCENE_EMPIRE_SEL:
                        self.do_select_empire(empire)
                        self._wait(2)

                    # nameInputBoard
                    nib = getattr(sw, 'nameInputBoard', None)
                    if nib:
                        # EditLine bul
                        name_edit = None
                        try:
                            nib_ch = getattr(nib, 'Children', None)
                            if nib_ch:
                                for nc in nib_ch:
                                    if 'EditLine' in type(nc).__name__:
                                        name_edit = nc
                                        break
                                    try:
                                        nc_ch = getattr(nc, 'Children', None)
                                        if nc_ch:
                                            for nc2 in nc_ch:
                                                if 'EditLine' in type(nc2).__name__:
                                                    name_edit = nc2
                                                    break
                                    except:
                                        pass
                                    if name_edit:
                                        break
                        except:
                            pass

                        if not name_edit:
                            for ea in ['nameValue', 'editLine', 'inputValue']:
                                ev = getattr(nib, ea, None)
                                if ev and hasattr(ev, 'SetText'):
                                    name_edit = ev
                                    break

                        if name_edit:
                            name_edit.SetText(name)
                            self._log('Isim girildi: %s' % name)

                        # OK butonu
                        try:
                            nib_ch = getattr(nib, 'Children', None)
                            if nib_ch:
                                for nc in nib_ch:
                                    if hasattr(nc, 'CallEvent'):
                                        nc.CallEvent()
                                        self._log('OK buton CallEvent OK')
                                        break
                        except:
                            pass

                    # Race set
                    try:
                        sw.raceIndex = race
                    except:
                        pass

                    # AcceptInputName / CreateCharacter
                    if hasattr(sw, 'AcceptInputName'):
                        try:
                            sw.AcceptInputName()
                            self._log('AcceptInputName OK')
                        except:
                            pass
                    elif hasattr(sw, 'CreateCharacter'):
                        try:
                            sw.CreateCharacter()
                            self._log('CreateCharacter OK')
                        except:
                            pass
                except Exception:
                    self._log('UI olusturma HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))

        # Olusturma sonucunu bekle
        self._log('Olusturma bekleniyor (25s)...')
        start = time.time()
        while time.time() - start < 25:
            self._wait(0.5)
            self.cm.refresh()
            if self.cm.char_count > pre_count:
                self._log('KARAKTER OLUSTU! count: %d -> %d' % (pre_count, self.cm.char_count))
                self.shm.set_status(ST_CHAR_CREATED)
                self.rec.record_event('CREATE_SUCCESS', 'name=%s' % name, None)
                return True

        # Timeout - tekrar dene farkli isimle
        retry_name = make_random_name()
        self._log('Timeout, farkli isimle deneniyor: %s' % retry_name)
        try:
            use_empire = empire
            try:
                eid = net_mod.GetEmpireID()
                if eid > 0:
                    use_empire = eid
            except:
                pass
            net_mod.SendCreateCharacterPacket(slot, retry_name, race, use_empire)
            start2 = time.time()
            while time.time() - start2 < 15:
                self._wait(0.5)
                self.cm.refresh()
                if self.cm.char_count > pre_count:
                    self._log('KARAKTER OLUSTU (2. deneme)! count: %d -> %d' % (pre_count, self.cm.char_count))
                    self.shm.set_status(ST_CHAR_CREATED)
                    return True
        except Exception:
            self._log('2. deneme HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))

        self._log('Karakter olusturma BASARISIZ')
        self.shm.set_status(ST_CHAR_FAIL)
        self.shm.set_error(ERR_CHAR_FAIL)
        return False

    # -------- OYUNA GIRIS --------
    def do_enter_game(self, slot=-1, target_name=''):
        self._log('Oyuna giris: slot=%d name=%s' % (slot, target_name))
        self.shm.set_status(ST_ENTERING_GAME)

        self.cm.refresh()

        # Hedef karakter bul
        target = None
        if target_name:
            target = self.cm.find_by_name(target_name)
        if not target and slot >= 0:
            target = self.cm.find_by_slot(slot)
        if not target and self.cm.characters:
            target = self.cm.characters[0]

        if not target:
            self._log('Girilecek karakter bulunamadi!')
            self.shm.set_status(ST_ENTER_FAIL)
            self.shm.set_error(ERR_ENTER_FAIL)
            return False

        sl = target['slot']
        self._log('Secilen: [%d] %s Lv.%d %s(%s)' % (
            sl, target['name'], target['level'], target['job'], target['gender']))

        # YONTEM 1: SelectCharacterWindow UI
        sw = self.sd.get_select_window()
        if sw:
            try:
                if hasattr(sw, 'SelectSlot'):
                    sw.SelectSlot(sl)
                    self._log('SelectSlot(%d) OK' % sl)
                try:
                    sw.slot = sl
                except:
                    pass
                if hasattr(sw, 'StartGame'):
                    sw.StartGame()
                    self._log('StartGame OK')
            except Exception:
                self._log('UI giris HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))

        # YONTEM 2: Paket
        try:
            net_mod.DirectEnter(sl)
            self._log('DirectEnter(%d) OK' % sl)
        except Exception:
            self._log('DirectEnter HATA: %s' % str(sys.exc_info()[1]))

        self.rec.record_event('ENTER_GAME', 'slot=%d name=%s' % (sl, target['name']), None)

        # Oyuna giris bekle
        self._log('Oyuna giris bekleniyor (30s)...')
        result_scene = self._wait_for_any_scene(
            [SCENE_GAME, SCENE_LOADING],
            timeout=30
        )
        if result_scene in (SCENE_GAME, SCENE_LOADING):
            self._log('OYUNA GIRILDI! scene=%d' % result_scene)
            self.shm.set_status(ST_IN_GAME)
            self.shm.set_error(ERR_NONE)
            self.rec.record_event('IN_GAME', 'OK', None)
            return True

        self._log('Oyuna giris TIMEOUT')
        self.shm.set_status(ST_ENTER_FAIL)
        self.shm.set_error(ERR_TIMEOUT)
        return False

    # -------- SAHNE DEGISTIRME --------
    def do_scene_change(self, target_scene_id):
        stm = self.sd.get_stream()
        if not stm:
            self._log('MainStream bulunamadi!')
            return False

        scene_map = {
            1: ('SetCreateCharacterPhase', SCENE_CHAR_CREATE),
            2: ('SetSelectCharacterPhase', SCENE_CHAR_SEL),
            3: ('SetSelectEmpirePhase', SCENE_EMPIRE_SEL),
            4: ('SetLoginPhase', SCENE_LOGIN),
        }
        entry = scene_map.get(target_scene_id, None)
        if not entry:
            self._log('Gecersiz sahne: %d' % target_scene_id)
            return False

        method_name, expected_scene = entry
        if not hasattr(stm, method_name):
            self._log('%s metodu yok!' % method_name)
            return False

        try:
            getattr(stm, method_name)()
            self._log('%s OK' % method_name)
        except Exception:
            self._log('%s HATA: %s' % (method_name, str(sys.exc_info()[1])))
            return False

        self.sd.invalidate()
        self._wait(1)
        return True

    # -------- RECOVERY --------
    def do_recovery(self, target_scene):
        self._log('Recovery: hedef sahne %d' % target_scene)
        self.shm.set_status(ST_RECOVERING)

        stm = self.sd.get_stream()
        if not stm:
            self._log('MainStream yok, recovery basarisiz')
            return False

        # Oncelikle karakter secim ekranina don
        if target_scene == SCENE_CHAR_SEL:
            if hasattr(stm, 'SetSelectCharacterPhase'):
                try:
                    stm.SetSelectCharacterPhase()
                    self._log('Recovery: SetSelectCharacterPhase OK')
                    self._wait(2)
                    self.sd.invalidate()
                    scene = self.sd.detect()
                    if scene == SCENE_CHAR_SEL:
                        return True
                except:
                    pass

        # Login ekranina don
        if target_scene == SCENE_LOGIN or target_scene == SCENE_SERVER_SEL:
            if hasattr(stm, 'SetLoginPhase'):
                try:
                    stm.SetLoginPhase()
                    self._log('Recovery: SetLoginPhase OK')
                    self._wait(2)
                    return True
                except:
                    pass

        return False

    # -------- AUTO ALL --------
    def do_auto_all(self):
        self._log('=== AUTO ALL BASLATILDI ===')
        self.shm.write_u32(OFF_AUTO_STATE, 1)  # Running

        # Parametreleri SHM'den oku
        srv_idx = self.shm.read_u32(OFF_SEL_SRV)
        ch_idx = self.shm.read_u32(OFF_SEL_CH)
        username = self.shm.read_str(OFF_USERNAME, 64)
        password = self.shm.read_str(OFF_PASSWORD, 64)
        create_race = self.shm.read_u32(OFF_CR_RACE)
        create_empire = self.shm.read_u32(OFF_CR_EMPIRE)
        create_count = self.shm.read_u32(OFF_CR_COUNT)
        target_slot = self.shm.read_u32(OFF_TARGET_SLOT)
        target_name = self.shm.read_str(OFF_TARGET_NAME, 64)
        create_name = self.shm.read_str(OFF_CREATE_NAME, 64)
        flags = self.shm.get_flags()
        random_name = (flags & FLAG_RANDOM_NAME) != 0

        if create_empire == 0:
            create_empire = 1
        if create_race == 0:
            create_race = 3

        self._log('AUTO params: srv=%d ch=%d user=%s race=%d emp=%d create_count=%d slot=%d name=%s' % (
            srv_idx, ch_idx, username, create_race, create_empire, create_count, target_slot, target_name))

        retry_count = 0

        while retry_count < MAX_RETRIES:
            # ETAP 1: Sahne tespit
            self.sd.invalidate()
            scene = self.sd.detect()
            self.shm.set_scene(scene)
            self._log('AUTO sahne: %d' % scene)

            # ETAP 1: Server/CH secimi
            if scene in (SCENE_LOGIN, SCENE_SERVER_SEL, SCENE_UNKNOWN):
                # Server secim ekraninda isek veya login ekraninda isek
                # Oncelikle server sec
                lw = self.sd.get_login_window()
                if lw:
                    try:
                        sb = getattr(lw, 'serverBoard', None)
                        if sb and sb.IsShow():
                            if not self.do_select_server(srv_idx, ch_idx):
                                retry_count += 1
                                self._wait(RETRY_INTERVAL)
                                continue
                            self._wait(1)
                    except:
                        pass

                # Sahne tekrar kontrol
                self.sd.invalidate()
                scene = self.sd.detect()
                self.shm.set_scene(scene)

            # ETAP 2: Login
            if scene == SCENE_LOGIN:
                if not username:
                    self._log('AUTO: Username bos, bekleniyor')
                    self.shm.set_status(ST_AT_LOGIN)
                    self.shm.write_u32(OFF_AUTO_STATE, 2)  # Waiting for input
                    return

                result = self.do_login(username, password)
                if not result:
                    status = self.shm.get_status()
                    error = self.shm.get_error()
                    if error == ERR_CONNECT_FAIL or error == ERR_LOGIN_FAIL:
                        err_msg = self.rec.login_result.get('msg', '')
                        # Maintenance check
                        if err_msg:
                            el = err_msg.lower()
                            if 'maintenance' in el or 'bakim' in el or 'repair' in el:
                                self._log('AUTO: Server bakim! %d dk sonra tekrar.' % (RETRY_INTERVAL / 60))
                                self.shm.set_status(ST_MAINTENANCE)
                                self.shm.set_error(ERR_MAINTENANCE)
                                self._wait(RETRY_INTERVAL)
                                retry_count += 1
                                continue
                        self._log('AUTO: Login basarisiz, %d dk sonra tekrar.' % (RETRY_INTERVAL / 60))
                        self._wait(RETRY_INTERVAL)
                        retry_count += 1
                        continue
                    self._log('AUTO: Login basarisiz, tekrar deniyor...')
                    retry_count += 1
                    self._wait(10)
                    continue

                # Login basarili, sahne kontrol
                self.sd.invalidate()
                scene = self.sd.detect()
                self.shm.set_scene(scene)

            # ETAP 3: Empire secimi (gerekirse)
            if scene == SCENE_EMPIRE_SEL:
                self.do_select_empire(create_empire)
                self._wait(2)
                self.sd.invalidate()
                scene = self.sd.detect()
                self.shm.set_scene(scene)

            # ETAP 4: Karakter secim
            if scene == SCENE_CHAR_SEL or scene == SCENE_CHAR_CREATE:
                self.cm.refresh()
                self._log('AUTO: Karakter sayisi: %d' % self.cm.char_count)

                # Karakter olusturma gerekli mi?
                if create_count > 0 and self.cm.char_count < MAX_CREATE_CHARS:
                    needed = min(create_count, MAX_CREATE_CHARS - self.cm.char_count)
                    if needed > 0 and self.cm.char_count == 0:
                        # Ilk karakter - empire secmemiz gerekebilir
                        try:
                            eid = net_mod.GetEmpireID()
                            if eid == 0:
                                self._log('AUTO: Empire secilemedi, seciliyor...')
                                self.do_select_empire(create_empire)
                                self._wait(3)
                                self.sd.invalidate()
                                scene = self.sd.detect()
                                self.shm.set_scene(scene)
                        except:
                            pass

                    for ci in range(needed):
                        self.cm.refresh()
                        if self.cm.char_count >= MAX_CREATE_CHARS:
                            break
                        cn = create_name if (not random_name and ci == 0 and create_name) else make_random_name()
                        self._log('AUTO: Karakter %d/%d olusturuluyor: %s' % (ci + 1, needed, cn))
                        result = self.do_create_character(create_race, create_empire, cn)
                        if not result:
                            self._log('AUTO: Olusturma basarisiz, recovery...')
                            self.do_recovery(SCENE_CHAR_SEL)
                            self._wait(2)
                            # Tekrar dene
                            cn2 = make_random_name()
                            result2 = self.do_create_character(create_race, create_empire, cn2)
                            if not result2:
                                self._log('AUTO: Olusturma 2. deneme de basarisiz!')
                                break
                        self._wait(1)
                        # Karakter secim ekranina don
                        self.sd.invalidate()
                        scene = self.sd.detect()
                        if scene != SCENE_CHAR_SEL:
                            self.do_recovery(SCENE_CHAR_SEL)
                            self._wait(2)

                # Simdi karakterleri yenile
                self.cm.refresh()

                if self.cm.char_count == 0:
                    self._log('AUTO: Hic karakter yok ve olusturulamadi!')
                    self.shm.set_status(ST_ERROR)
                    self.shm.set_error(ERR_CHAR_FAIL)
                    self.shm.write_u32(OFF_AUTO_STATE, 3)  # Error
                    return

                # ETAP 5: Oyuna gir
                self._log('AUTO: Oyuna giris...')
                result = self.do_enter_game(target_slot, target_name)
                if result:
                    self._log('=== AUTO ALL TAMAMLANDI ===')
                    self.shm.write_u32(OFF_AUTO_STATE, 4)  # Complete
                    return
                else:
                    self._log('AUTO: Oyuna giris basarisiz, recovery...')
                    self.do_recovery(SCENE_CHAR_SEL)
                    self._wait(3)
                    # Tekrar dene
                    result2 = self.do_enter_game(target_slot, target_name)
                    if result2:
                        self._log('=== AUTO ALL TAMAMLANDI (2. deneme) ===')
                        self.shm.write_u32(OFF_AUTO_STATE, 4)
                        return
                    retry_count += 1
                    continue

            # Bilinmeyen sahne
            self._log('AUTO: Bilinmeyen sahne %d, bekleniyor...' % scene)
            self._wait(3)
            retry_count += 1

        self._log('AUTO ALL MAX RETRY ASILDI!')
        self.shm.set_status(ST_ERROR)
        self.shm.write_u32(OFF_AUTO_STATE, 3)


# ============================================================
#  ANA KONTROL DONGUSU
# ============================================================

class MaximumController(object):
    def __init__(self):
        self.shm = SharedMemoryManager()
        self.rec = Recorder(self.shm)
        self.sd = SceneDetector()
        self.cm = CharacterManager(self.shm, self.rec, self.sd)
        self.ae = ActionExecutor(self.shm, self.rec, self.sd, self.cm)
        self.running = False

    def start(self):
        # Coklu instance kontrolu
        if hasattr(sys, '_max_running') and sys._max_running:
            sys._max_stop = True
            time.sleep(0.5)
        sys._max_running = True
        sys._max_stop = False

        # Log dosyalarini temizle
        for fp in (LOG_FILE, RESULT_FILE):
            try:
                f = open(fp, 'w')
                f.write('')
                f.close()
            except:
                pass

        # SharedMemory olustur
        if not self.shm.create():
            append_log('HATA: SharedMemory olusturulamadi!')
            return

        # Recorder kur
        self.rec.setup()

        # Baslangic sahne tespiti
        scene = self.sd.detect()
        self.shm.set_scene(scene)

        # Server/channel bilgilerini doldur
        lw = self.sd.get_login_window()
        if lw:
            try:
                sl = lw.serverList
                sl_count = sl.GetItemCount()
                self.shm.write_u32(OFF_SRV_COUNT, sl_count)
                for i in range(min(sl_count, 4)):
                    try:
                        txt = sl.GetItemText(i)
                        self.shm.write_server_name(i, safe_str(txt))
                    except:
                        pass
            except:
                pass
            try:
                cl = lw.channelList
                cl_count = cl.GetItemCount()
                self.shm.write_u32(OFF_CH_COUNT, cl_count)
                for i in range(min(cl_count, 4)):
                    try:
                        txt = cl.GetItemText(i)
                        self.shm.write_channel_name(i, safe_str(txt))
                    except:
                        pass
            except:
                pass

        self.shm.set_status(ST_READY)

        append_log('========================================')
        append_log('  MaximumPyScriptx v1.0 BASLATILDI')
        append_log('  PID: %d' % os.getpid())
        append_log('  SHM: %s' % self.shm.shm_name)
        append_log('  Sahne: %d' % scene)
        append_log('  Locale: %d' % self.rec.locale_count)
        append_log('========================================')

        self.running = True
        self.run_loop()

    def run_loop(self):
        last_scene_update = 0

        while self.running:
            # Durdurma istegi
            if getattr(sys, '_max_stop', False):
                append_log('DURDURMA ISTEGI')
                break

            now = time.time()

            # Sahne guncelle (her 0.5s)
            if now - last_scene_update >= 0.5:
                self.sd.invalidate()
                scene = self.sd.detect()
                self.shm.set_scene(scene)
                last_scene_update = now

            # Komut kontrol
            cmd = self.shm.get_command()
            if cmd != CMD_NONE:
                self.shm.clear_command()
                self._handle_command(cmd)

            time.sleep(COMMAND_POLL)

        # Temizlik
        self.running = False
        sys._max_running = False
        sys._max_stop = False
        self.rec.restore()
        self.shm.set_status(ST_IDLE)
        self.shm.close()
        append_log('MaximumPyScriptx KAPATILDI')

    def _handle_command(self, cmd):
        append_log('Komut alindi: %d' % cmd)

        if cmd == CMD_SELECT_SERVER:
            srv = self.shm.get_param(1)
            ch = self.shm.get_param(2)
            self.ae.do_select_server(srv, ch)

        elif cmd == CMD_LOGIN:
            username = self.shm.read_str(OFF_USERNAME, 64)
            password = self.shm.read_str(OFF_PASSWORD, 64)
            self.ae.do_login(username, password)

        elif cmd == CMD_SELECT_CHAR:
            slot = self.shm.get_param(1)
            self.cm.refresh()
            # Sadece refresh yap, karakter bilgilerini guncelle

        elif cmd == CMD_CREATE_CHAR:
            race = self.shm.get_param(1)
            empire = self.shm.get_param(2)
            count = self.shm.get_param(3)
            name = self.shm.read_str(OFF_CREATE_NAME, 64)
            flags = self.shm.get_flags()
            random_name = (flags & FLAG_RANDOM_NAME) != 0

            if count <= 0:
                count = 1
            if empire == 0:
                empire = 1

            # Empire secimi gerekli mi?
            self.cm.refresh()
            if self.cm.char_count == 0:
                try:
                    eid = net_mod.GetEmpireID()
                    if eid == 0:
                        self.ae.do_select_empire(empire)
                        self._wait_safe(3)
                except:
                    pass

            for i in range(count):
                self.cm.refresh()
                if self.cm.char_count >= MAX_CREATE_CHARS:
                    append_log('Max karakter sayisina ulasildi!')
                    break
                cn = name if (not random_name and i == 0 and name) else make_random_name()
                self.ae.do_create_character(race, empire, cn)
                self._wait_safe(1)

        elif cmd == CMD_ENTER_GAME:
            slot = self.shm.get_param(1)
            target_name = self.shm.read_str(OFF_TARGET_NAME, 64)
            self.ae.do_enter_game(slot, target_name)

        elif cmd == CMD_SELECT_EMPIRE:
            empire = self.shm.get_param(1)
            self.ae.do_select_empire(empire)

        elif cmd == CMD_REFRESH:
            self.sd.invalidate()
            scene = self.sd.detect()
            self.shm.set_scene(scene)
            if scene in (SCENE_CHAR_SEL, SCENE_CHAR_CREATE):
                self.cm.refresh()
            # Server/CH bilgilerini guncelle
            lw = self.sd.get_login_window()
            if lw:
                try:
                    sl = lw.serverList
                    sl_count = sl.GetItemCount()
                    self.shm.write_u32(OFF_SRV_COUNT, sl_count)
                    for i in range(min(sl_count, 4)):
                        try:
                            txt = sl.GetItemText(i)
                            self.shm.write_server_name(i, safe_str(txt))
                        except:
                            pass
                except:
                    pass
                try:
                    cl = lw.channelList
                    cl_count = cl.GetItemCount()
                    self.shm.write_u32(OFF_CH_COUNT, cl_count)
                    for i in range(min(cl_count, 4)):
                        try:
                            txt = cl.GetItemText(i)
                            self.shm.write_channel_name(i, safe_str(txt))
                        except:
                            pass
                except:
                    pass
            self.shm.set_status(ST_READY)

        elif cmd == CMD_AUTO_ALL:
            self.ae.do_auto_all()

        elif cmd == CMD_SCENE_CHANGE:
            target = self.shm.get_param(1)
            self.ae.do_scene_change(target)

        elif cmd == CMD_STOP:
            append_log('STOP komutu alindi')
            self.running = False

    def _wait_safe(self, seconds):
        time.sleep(seconds)


# ============================================================
#  BASLAT
# ============================================================

_controller = MaximumController()

try:
    import thread as _thread
    _thread.start_new_thread(_controller.start, ())
    append_log('Thread ile baslatildi')
except:
    append_log('Thread basarisiz, direkt baslat')
    _controller.start()

// MaximumController.cpp
// Win32 API Metin2 Controller
// Compile: cl /EHsc MaximumController.cpp /link user32.lib gdi32.lib comctl32.lib

// ============================================================
//  SHARED MEMORY LAYOUT (MaximumPyScriptx ile eslesik)

// Flags
#define FLAG_RECORDING    0x01

// Auto states
#define AUTO_IDLE         0

// ============================================================
//  CONTROL IDS
// ============================================================
#define IDC_EDIT_PID          101

#define IDC_BTN_ENTER_GAME    112

#define IDC_EDIT_CHARNAME     116

// ============================================================
//  SHARED MEMORY HELPERS
// ============================================================

static DWORD ReadU32(DWORD offset)
{
    if (!g_pBuf) return 0;
    return *(DWORD*)((BYTE*)g_pBuf + offset);
}

static void WriteU32(DWORD offset, DWORD value)
{
    if (!g_pBuf) return;
    *(DWORD*)((BYTE*)g_pBuf + offset) = value;
}

static void ReadStr(DWORD offset, char* buf, int maxLen)
{
    if (!g_pBuf) { buf[0] = 0; return; }
    memcpy(buf, (BYTE*)g_pBuf + offset, maxLen);
    buf[maxLen - 1] = 0;
}

static void WriteStr(DWORD offset, const char* str, int maxLen)
{
    if (!g_pBuf) return;
    int len = (int)strlen(str);
    if (len >= maxLen) len = maxLen - 1;
    memcpy((BYTE*)g_pBuf + offset, str, len);
    memset((BYTE*)g_pBuf + offset + len, 0, maxLen - len);
}

static void SendCommand(DWORD cmd, DWORD p1 = 0, DWORD p2 = 0, DWORD p3 = 0, DWORD p4 = 0)
{
    if (!g_pBuf) return;
    WriteU32(OFF_PARAM1, p1);
    WriteU32(OFF_PARAM2, p2);
    WriteU32(OFF_PARAM3, p3);
    WriteU32(OFF_PARAM4, p4);
    WriteU32(OFF_COMMAND, cmd);
}

// ============================================================
//  LOG HELPERS
// ============================================================

static void AddLog(const char* msg)
{
    if (!g_hListLog) return;
    // Timestamp
    SYSTEMTIME st;
    GetLocalTime(&st);
    char buf[512];
    _snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "[%02d:%02d:%02d] %s",
        st.wHour, st.wMinute, st.wSecond, msg);
    buf[sizeof(buf) - 1] = 0;
    SendMessageA(g_hListLog, LB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)buf);
    int count = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListLog, LB_GETCOUNT, 0, 0);
    SendMessageA(g_hListLog, LB_SETTOPINDEX, count - 1, 0);
}

static void ReadShmLogs()
{
    if (!g_pBuf) return;
    DWORD wpos = ReadU32(OFF_LOG_WPOS);
    DWORD rpos = g_LastLogRPos;
    if (wpos == rpos) return;

    int bufSize = 1024;
    while (rpos < wpos)
    {
        // Mesaj uzunlugunu oku (2 byte)
        if (wpos - rpos < 2) break;
        BYTE lo = *((BYTE*)g_pBuf + OFF_LOG_BUF + (rpos % bufSize));
        rpos++;
        BYTE hi = *((BYTE*)g_pBuf + OFF_LOG_BUF + (rpos % bufSize));
        rpos++;
        int msgLen = lo | (hi << 8);
        if (msgLen <= 0 || msgLen > 200) { rpos = wpos; break; }
        if (wpos - rpos < (DWORD)msgLen) break;

        char msg[256];
        for (int i = 0; i < msgLen && i < 255; i++)
        {
            msg[i] = *((BYTE*)g_pBuf + OFF_LOG_BUF + (rpos % bufSize));
            rpos++;
        }
        msg[msgLen < 255 ? msgLen : 255] = 0;
        AddLog(msg);
    }
    g_LastLogRPos = rpos;
}

{
    switch (scene) {
    case SCENE_UNKNOWN:     return "Bilinmiyor";
    case SCENE_LOGIN:       return "Login Ekrani";
    case SCENE_SERVER_SEL:  return "Server Secimi";
    case SCENE_CHAR_SEL:    return "Karakter Secimi";

    case SCENE_CHAR_CREATE: return "Karakter Olusturma";

// ============================================================
//  UI UPDATE (Timer ile cagirilir)
// ============================================================

static void UpdateUI()
{
    if (!g_Connected || !g_pBuf) return;

    // Magic kontrol
    DWORD magic = ReadU32(OFF_MAGIC);
    if (magic != MAGIC_VALUE)
    {
        SetWindowTextA(g_hLblConnection, "Baglanti: KOPUK (magic hatasi)");
        return;
    }

    // Scene
    DWORD scene = ReadU32(OFF_SCENE);
    char sceneBuf[128];
    _snprintf(sceneBuf, sizeof(sceneBuf), "Sahne: %s (%d)", GetSceneName(scene), scene);
    SetWindowTextA(g_hLblScene, sceneBuf);

    // Status
    DWORD status = ReadU32(OFF_STATUS);
    char statusBuf[128];
    _snprintf(statusBuf, sizeof(statusBuf), "Durum: %s (%d)", GetStatusName(status), status);
    SetWindowTextA(g_hLblStatus, statusBuf);

    // Error
    DWORD err = ReadU32(OFF_ERROR);
    char errBuf[128];
    _snprintf(errBuf, sizeof(errBuf), "Hata: %s (%d)", GetErrorName(err), err);
    SetWindowTextA(g_hLblError, errBuf);

    // Char count
    DWORD charCount = ReadU32(OFF_CHAR_COUNT);
    char ccBuf[64];
    _snprintf(ccBuf, sizeof(ccBuf), "Karakter: %d / 4", charCount);
    SetWindowTextA(g_hLblCharCount, ccBuf);

    // Auto state
    DWORD autoState = ReadU32(OFF_AUTO_STATE);
    char asBuf[128];
    _snprintf(asBuf, sizeof(asBuf), "Auto: %s (%d)", GetAutoStateName(autoState), autoState);
    SetWindowTextA(g_hLblAutoState, asBuf);

    // Connection
    SetWindowTextA(g_hLblConnection, "Baglanti: AKTIF");

    // Read SHM logs
    ReadShmLogs();

    // Server listesini guncelle (sadece ilk basta veya refresh sonrasi)
    static DWORD lastSrvCount = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    DWORD srvCount = ReadU32(OFF_SRV_COUNT);
    if (srvCount != lastSrvCount)
    {
        SendMessageA(g_hListServers, LB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0);
        for (DWORD i = 0; i < srvCount && i < 4; i++)
        {
            char name[20];
            ReadStr(OFF_SRV_NAMES + i * 16, name, 16);
            SendMessageA(g_hListServers, LB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)name);
        }
        lastSrvCount = srvCount;
    }

    // Channel listesini guncelle
    static DWORD lastChCount = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    DWORD chCount = ReadU32(OFF_CH_COUNT);
    if (chCount != lastChCount)
    {
        SendMessageA(g_hListChannels, LB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0);
        for (DWORD i = 0; i < chCount && i < 4; i++)
        {
            char name[20];
            ReadStr(OFF_CH_NAMES + i * 16, name, 16);
            SendMessageA(g_hListChannels, LB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)name);
        }
        lastChCount = chCount;
    }

    // Karakter listesi guncelle
    static DWORD lastCharCountUI = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    if (charCount != lastCharCountUI)
    {
        SendMessageA(g_hListChars, LB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0);
        SendMessageA(g_hComboTargetSlot, CB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        {
            char name[20];
            ReadStr(OFF_CHAR_NAMES + i * 16, name, 16);
            DWORD race = ReadU32(OFF_CHAR_INFO + i * 16);
            DWORD level = ReadU32(OFF_CHAR_INFO + i * 16 + 4);
            DWORD exists = ReadU32(OFF_CHAR_INFO + i * 16 + 8);

            char line[128];
            if (exists)
            {
                const char* jobs[] = {"Warrior(M)","Ninja(F)","Sura(M)","Shaman(F)",
                                       "Warrior(F)","Ninja(M)","Sura(F)","Shaman(M)","Lycan(M)"};
                const char* jn = (race < 9) ? jobs[race] : "?";
                _snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%d] %s | Lv.%d | %s", i, name, level, jn);
                SendMessageA(g_hListChars, LB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)line);

                char slotLine[64];
                _snprintf(slotLine, sizeof(slotLine), "Slot %d: %s", i, name);
                SendMessageA(g_hComboTargetSlot, CB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)slotLine);
            }
            else
            {
                _snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%d] BOS", i);
                SendMessageA(g_hListChars, LB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)line);

                char slotLine[64];
                _snprintf(slotLine, sizeof(slotLine), "Slot %d: BOS", i);
                SendMessageA(g_hComboTargetSlot, CB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)slotLine);
            }
        }
        if (SendMessageA(g_hComboTargetSlot, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0) == CB_ERR)
            SendMessageA(g_hComboTargetSlot, CB_SETCURSEL, 0, 0);
        lastCharCountUI = charCount;
    }
}

// ============================================================
//  CONNECT TO SHM
// ============================================================

static BOOL ConnectToShm(DWORD pid)
{
    if (g_pBuf)
    {
        UnmapViewOfFile(g_pBuf);
        g_pBuf = NULL;
    }
    if (g_hMapFile)
    {
        CloseHandle(g_hMapFile);
        g_hMapFile = NULL;
    }

    char shmName[64];
    _snprintf(shmName, sizeof(shmName), "Control_%u", pid);

    g_hMapFile = OpenFileMappingA(FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS, FALSE, shmName);
    if (!g_hMapFile)
    {
        AddLog("SharedMemory acilamadi!");
        char err[128];
        _snprintf(err, sizeof(err), "  SHM: %s (GetLastError=%d)", shmName, GetLastError());
        AddLog(err);
        g_Connected = FALSE;
        return FALSE;
    }

    g_pBuf = MapViewOfFile(g_hMapFile, FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS, 0, 0, SHM_SIZE);
    if (!g_pBuf)
    {
        AddLog("MapViewOfFile hatasi!");
        CloseHandle(g_hMapFile);
        g_hMapFile = NULL;
        g_Connected = FALSE;
        return FALSE;
    }

    // Magic kontrol
    DWORD magic = ReadU32(OFF_MAGIC);
    if (magic != MAGIC_VALUE)
    {
        char err[128];
        _snprintf(err, sizeof(err), "Magic hatasi: 0x%08X (beklenen 0x%08X)", magic, MAGIC_VALUE);
        AddLog(err);
        UnmapViewOfFile(g_pBuf);
        g_pBuf = NULL;
        CloseHandle(g_hMapFile);
        g_hMapFile = NULL;
        g_Connected = FALSE;
        return FALSE;
    }

    g_Connected = TRUE;
    g_TargetPid = pid;
    g_LastLogRPos = ReadU32(OFF_LOG_RPOS);

    char msg[128];
    _snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Baglandi: PID=%u SHM=%s", pid, shmName);
    AddLog(msg);

    // Refresh komutu gonder
    SendCommand(CMD_REFRESH);

    return TRUE;
}
