    case WM_TIMER:
        if (wParam == IDC_TIMER_POLL)
        {
            UpdateUI();
        }
        break;

    case WM_COMMAND:
    {
        int wmId = LOWORD(wParam);

        switch (wmId)
        {
        case IDC_BTN_CONNECT:
        {
            char pidStr[32];
            GetWindowTextA(g_hEditPid, pidStr, sizeof(pidStr));
            DWORD pid = (DWORD)atoi(pidStr);
            if (pid == 0)
            {
                AddLog("Gecersiz PID!");
                break;
            }
            ConnectToShm(pid);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_SELECT_SERVER:
        {
            if (!g_Connected) { AddLog("Baglantiyi yok!"); break; }
            int srv = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListServers, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            int ch = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListChannels, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (srv < 0) srv = 0;
            if (ch < 0) ch = 0;
            char msg[128];
            _snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Server secimi: srv=%d ch=%d", srv, ch);
            AddLog(msg);
            SendCommand(CMD_SELECT_SERVER, srv, ch);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_LOGIN:
        {
            if (!g_Connected) { AddLog("Baglanti yok!"); break; }
            char user[64], pass[64];
            GetWindowTextA(g_hEditUser, user, sizeof(user));
            GetWindowTextA(g_hEditPass, pass, sizeof(pass));
            if (strlen(user) == 0) { AddLog("Kullanici adi bos!"); break; }
            WriteStr(OFF_USERNAME, user, 64);
            WriteStr(OFF_PASSWORD, pass, 64);
            AddLog("Login komutu gonderiliyor...");
            SendCommand(CMD_LOGIN);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_EMPIRE:
        {
            if (!g_Connected) { AddLog("Baglanti yok!"); break; }
            int sel = (int)SendMessageA(g_hComboEmpire, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            int empireId = sel + 1;
            char msg[64];
            _snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Empire secimi: %d", empireId);
            AddLog(msg);
            SendCommand(CMD_SELECT_EMPIRE, empireId);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_CREATE_CHAR:
        {
            if (!g_Connected) { AddLog("Baglanti yok!"); break; }
            int raceSel = (int)SendMessageA(g_hComboJob, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (raceSel < 0) raceSel = 3;
            int empireSel = (int)SendMessageA(g_hComboEmpire, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            int empireId = empireSel + 1;

            char countStr[16];
            GetWindowTextA(g_hEditCreateCount, countStr, sizeof(countStr));
            int count = atoi(countStr);
            if (count <= 0) count = 1;
            if (count > 4) count = 4;

            BOOL randomName = (SendMessageA(g_hChkRandom, BM_GETCHECK, 0, 0) == BST_CHECKED);
            char charName[64] = "";
            if (!randomName)
            {
                GetWindowTextA(g_hEditCharName, charName, sizeof(charName));
            }

            // SHM'ye yaz
            WriteStr(OFF_CREATE_NAME, charName, 64);
            DWORD flags = ReadU32(OFF_FLAGS);
            if (randomName)
                flags |= FLAG_RANDOM_NAME;
            else
                flags &= ~FLAG_RANDOM_NAME;
            WriteU32(OFF_FLAGS, flags);

            char msg[128];
            _snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Karakter olustur: race=%d empire=%d count=%d name=%s random=%d",
                raceSel, empireId, count, charName, randomName);
            AddLog(msg);
            SendCommand(CMD_CREATE_CHAR, raceSel, empireId, count);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_ENTER_GAME:
        {
            if (!g_Connected) { AddLog("Baglanti yok!"); break; }
            int slotSel = (int)SendMessageA(g_hComboTargetSlot, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (slotSel < 0) slotSel = 0;
            char targetName[64] = "";
            GetWindowTextA(g_hEditTargetName, targetName, sizeof(targetName));
            WriteStr(OFF_TARGET_NAME, targetName, 64);
            char msg[128];
            _snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Oyuna gir: slot=%d name=%s", slotSel, targetName);
            AddLog(msg);
            SendCommand(CMD_ENTER_GAME, slotSel);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_AUTO_ALL:
        {
            if (!g_Connected) { AddLog("Baglanti yok!"); break; }
            // Tum parametreleri SHM'ye yaz
            int srv = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListServers, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            int ch = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListChannels, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (srv < 0) srv = 0;
            if (ch < 0) ch = 0;

            char user[64], pass[64];
            GetWindowTextA(g_hEditUser, user, sizeof(user));
            GetWindowTextA(g_hEditPass, pass, sizeof(pass));
            WriteStr(OFF_USERNAME, user, 64);
            WriteStr(OFF_PASSWORD, pass, 64);
            WriteU32(OFF_SEL_SRV, srv);
            WriteU32(OFF_SEL_CH, ch);

            int raceSel = (int)SendMessageA(g_hComboJob, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (raceSel < 0) raceSel = 3;
            int empireSel = (int)SendMessageA(g_hComboEmpire, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            int empireId = empireSel + 1;

            char countStr[16];
            GetWindowTextA(g_hEditCreateCount, countStr, sizeof(countStr));
            int count = atoi(countStr);
            if (count < 0) count = 0;
            if (count > 4) count = 4;

            BOOL randomName = (SendMessageA(g_hChkRandom, BM_GETCHECK, 0, 0) == BST_CHECKED);
            char charName[64] = "";
            if (!randomName)
                GetWindowTextA(g_hEditCharName, charName, sizeof(charName));
            WriteStr(OFF_CREATE_NAME, charName, 64);

            char targetName[64] = "";
            GetWindowTextA(g_hEditTargetName, targetName, sizeof(targetName));
            WriteStr(OFF_TARGET_NAME, targetName, 64);

            int slotSel = (int)SendMessageA(g_hComboTargetSlot, CB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (slotSel < 0) slotSel = 0;
            WriteU32(OFF_TARGET_SLOT, slotSel);

            WriteU32(OFF_CR_RACE, raceSel);
            WriteU32(OFF_CR_EMPIRE, empireId);
            WriteU32(OFF_CR_COUNT, count);

            DWORD flags = 0;
            if (randomName) flags |= FLAG_RANDOM_NAME;
            flags |= FLAG_AUTO_MODE;
            WriteU32(OFF_FLAGS, flags);

            AddLog("=== AUTO ALL BASLATILDI ===");
            char msg[256];
            _snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "srv=%d ch=%d user=%s race=%d emp=%d count=%d slot=%d target=%s",
                srv, ch, user, raceSel, empireId, count, slotSel, targetName);
            AddLog(msg);

            SendCommand(CMD_AUTO_ALL);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_REFRESH:
        {
            if (!g_Connected) { AddLog("Baglanti yok!"); break; }
            AddLog("Yenileme istegi...");
            SendCommand(CMD_REFRESH);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_STOP:
        {
            if (!g_Connected) { AddLog("Baglanti yok!"); break; }
            AddLog("Durdurma komutu gonderiliyor...");
            SendCommand(CMD_STOP);
            break;
        }

        case IDC_BTN_SAVE_LOG:
        {
            int count = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListLog, LB_GETCOUNT, 0, 0);
            if (count <= 0) { AddLog("Log bos!"); break; }

            OPENFILENAMEA ofn;
            char filename[MAX_PATH] = "maximum_log.txt";
            ZeroMemory(&ofn, sizeof(ofn));
            ofn.lStructSize = sizeof(ofn);
            ofn.hwndOwner = hWnd;
            ofn.lpstrFilter = "Text Files (*.txt)\0*.txt\0All Files (*.*)\0*.*\0";
            ofn.lpstrFile = filename;
            ofn.nMaxFile = MAX_PATH;
            ofn.Flags = OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT;
            ofn.lpstrDefExt = "txt";

            if (GetSaveFileNameA(&ofn))
            {
                FILE* fp = fopen(filename, "w");
                if (fp)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                    {
                        char line[512];
                        int len = (int)SendMessageA(g_hListLog, LB_GETTEXT, i, (LPARAM)line);
                        if (len > 0)
                        {
                            line[len] = 0;
                            fprintf(fp, "%s\n", line);
                        }
                    }
                    fclose(fp);
                    char msg[256];
                    _snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Log kaydedildi: %s (%d satir)", filename, count);
                    AddLog(msg);
                }
                else
                {
                    AddLog("Dosya acilamadi!");
                }
            }
            break;
        }
        }
        break;
    }

    case WM_DESTROY:
        KillTimer(hWnd, IDC_TIMER_POLL);
        if (g_pBuf)
        {
            UnmapViewOfFile(g_pBuf);
            g_pBuf = NULL;
        }
        if (g_hMapFile)
        {
            CloseHandle(g_hMapFile);
            g_hMapFile = NULL;
        }
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        break;

    default:
        return DefWindowProcA(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return 0;
}

// ============================================================
//  WINMAIN
// ============================================================

int WINAPI WinMain(HINSTANCE hInstance, HINSTANCE, LPSTR, int nCmdShow)
{
    g_hInst = hInstance;

    INITCOMMONCONTROLSEX icc;
    icc.dwSize = sizeof(icc);
    icc.dwICC = ICC_WIN95_CLASSES;
    InitCommonControlsEx(&icc);

    WNDCLASSEXA wc;
    ZeroMemory(&wc, sizeof(wc));
    wc.cbSize = sizeof(wc);
    wc.style = CS_HREDRAW | CS_VREDRAW;
    wc.lpfnWndProc = WndProc;
    wc.hInstance = hInstance;
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(NULL, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)(COLOR_BTNFACE + 1);
    wc.lpszClassName = "MaxCtrlClass";
    wc.hIcon = LoadIcon(NULL, IDI_APPLICATION);
    wc.hIconSm = LoadIcon(NULL, IDI_APPLICATION);

    RegisterClassExA(&wc);

    g_hWnd = CreateWindowExA(
        0, "MaxCtrlClass", "Maximum Controller v1.0",
        WS_OVERLAPPED | WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU | WS_MINIMIZEBOX,
        CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT,
        810, 620,
        NULL, NULL, hInstance, NULL);

    ShowWindow(g_hWnd, nCmdShow);
    UpdateWindow(g_hWnd);

    MSG msg;
    while (GetMessage(&msg, NULL, 0, 0))
    {
        TranslateMessage(&msg);
        DispatchMessage(&msg);
    }

    return (int)msg.wParam;
}

## Derleme ve Kullanım

### C++ Derleme (Visual Studio Command Prompt):
```batch
cl /EHsc /O2 MaximumController.cpp /link user32.lib gdi32.lib comctl32.lib comdlg32.lib /OUT:MaximumController.exe
```

### Kullanım Sırası:

1. **Metin2 client'ı aç** ve login ekranına gel
2. **MaximumPyScriptx.txt'yi çalıştır:**
   ```
   py exec(open('C:/MaximumPyScriptx.txt').read())
   ```
3. Script konsolda PID'ini yazdırır: `[MAX] SharedMemory olusturuldu: Control_1234 (PID=1234)`
4. **MaximumController.exe'yi aç**
5. PID alanına `1234` yaz ve **Bağlan** butonuna bas
6. **Manual mod:** Etap 1 → Etap 2 → Etap 3 sırasıyla ilerle
7. **Otomatik mod:** Tüm alanları doldur ve **AUTO ALL** butonuna bas

### SharedMemory İletişim Akışı:
```
MaximumController.exe  ←→  SharedMemory (Control_PID)  ←→  MaximumPyScriptx.txt
     [Komut yaz]                                              [Komut oku + çalıştır]
     [Durum oku]                                              [Durum yaz]
     [Log oku]                                                [Log yaz]
```"

## Sistem Karşılaştırması

| Özellik | Sistem 1 | Sistem 2 |
|---------|----------|----------|
| IPC | mmap (JSON) | mmap + ctypes fallback (binary struct) |
| Server/CH seç | ❌ çalışmıyor | ✅ çalışıyor |
| Login | ❌ çalışmıyor | ✅ çalışıyor (k.adı/şifre girer) |
| Karakter listesi | - | ⚠️ bazen BOŞ gösteriyor |
| Bayrak seçimi | - | ❌ paket deniyor, başarısız |
| Karakter oluşturma | - | ❌ bayrak seçemediği için |
| Oyuna giriş | - | ✅ isimle çalışıyor |
| Sahne değiştirme | - | ✅ MainStream |
| Recovery/Retry | basit | ✅ gelişmiş state machine |
| Recorder | minimal | ✅ chat hook + locale reverse |

**Seçim: Sistem 2** — çok daha güçlü, temel işlevler çalışıyor, buglar düzeltilebilir.

## Tespit Edilen 4 Bug:

1. **Karakter listesi BOŞ** → `CharacterManager.refresh()` çok erken çağrılıyor, server'dan veri gelmemiş. Bekleme + retry lazım.
2. **Bayrak seçimi başarısız** → Sadece `OnSelectEmpire` + `SendSelectEmpirePacket` deniyor. helperBayrak'taki **EmpireButton.CallEvent** + alpha set yöntemi entegre edilmeli.
3. **Disconnect sonrası login** → `_find_object` cache'i stale kalıyor. `invalidate()` çağrılmalı ve LoginWindow yeniden bulunmalı.
4. **CEffectManager hataları** → Bunlar oyun kaynak hataları, script ile ilgili değil, ignore.

## 🔧 Sistem 2 Bug Fix'leri Uygulandı

### ✅ Bug 1: Karakter listesi "BOŞ BOŞ BOŞ BOŞ" sorunu
**Sebep:** `CharacterManager.refresh()` karakter seçim ekranına geçer geçmez çağrılıyordu, server'dan veri henüz gelmemişti.

> ## Problem 1: Character list showing BOS (empty5) even though characters exist

> 3. But **who triggers refresh?**

> Actually, this is a known Metin2 issue - when you inject Python code that runs in a thread, it can interfere with the game's rendering because Python's GIL can block the game's main thread. The game's C++ code calls into Python for rendering, and if another Python thread is holding the GIL, the rendering thread gets blocked.
